name: CCUS facility
definition: An integrated facility or asset system used to capture, condition, transport, use, inject, store or monitor carbon dioxide.

name: carbon capture plant
definition: A plant that separates carbon dioxide from a gas stream for compression, transport, utilization or storage.

name: post-combustion capture unit
definition: A carbon capture unit that separates CO2 from flue gas after combustion.

name: pre-combustion capture unit
definition: A carbon capture unit that removes CO2 from synthesis gas or shifted gas before combustion.

name: oxyfuel capture unit
definition: A carbon capture unit based on combustion in oxygen-rich conditions to produce a CO2-rich exhaust stream.

name: direct air capture unit
definition: A capture unit that removes CO2 directly from ambient air.

name: membrane CO2 separation unit
definition: A capture unit using membranes to separate CO2 from a gas stream.

name: adsorption CO2 capture unit
definition: A capture unit using adsorption media and cyclic regeneration to separate CO2.

name: CO2 absorber column
definition: A column where CO2 is absorbed from a gas stream into a solvent or other capture medium.

name: CO2 stripper column
definition: A column where captured CO2 is released from solvent or capture medium by regeneration.

name: solvent reboiler
definition: A heat exchanger that provides heat for solvent regeneration in a carbon capture process.

name: solvent reclaiming package
definition: A package that removes degradation products, contaminants or heat-stable salts from capture solvent.

name: solvent storage tank
definition: A tank used to store capture solvent or solvent make-up chemicals.

name: flue gas conditioning unit
definition: Equipment used to condition gas before CO2 capture, including cooling, particulate removal or contaminant control.

name: CO2 dehydration package
definition: A package that removes water from a CO2 stream to meet transport, corrosion or storage specifications.
searchText: CO2 conditioning and corrosion control class.

name: CO2 compression train
definition: A compression train that increases CO2 stream pressure for transport, injection or utilization.

name: CO2 compressor
definition: A compressor intended to increase pressure of carbon dioxide stream.

name: CO2 pump
definition: A pump used to move dense-phase or liquid carbon dioxide.

name: CO2 metering station
definition: A station that measures CO2 flow quantity, quality, pressure, temperature or composition for allocation, custody transfer or reporting.

name: CO2 analyzer package
definition: An analyzer package that measures CO2 purity, contaminants, water content or composition.

name: CO2 pipeline system
definition: A pipeline system used to transport CO2 streams between capture, utilization or storage facilities.

name: onshore CO2 pipeline
definition: A CO2 pipeline located onshore.

name: offshore CO2 pipeline
definition: A CO2 pipeline located offshore or subsea.

name: CO2 block valve station
definition: A station containing valves used to isolate sections of a CO2 pipeline.

name: CO2 vent station
definition: A station or facility used to vent, depressurize or safely dispose of CO2 from a system.
searchText: CO2 pipeline safety and operations class.

name: CO2 shipping terminal
definition: A terminal used to load, unload, buffer or condition carbon dioxide for marine transport.

name: liquid CO2 storage tank
definition: A storage tank used for temporary storage of liquefied carbon dioxide.

name: CO2 ship loading arm
definition: Equipment used to transfer carbon dioxide between terminal and ship.

name: CO2 utilization unit
definition: A unit that uses carbon dioxide as a feedstock or reactant in a downstream process.

name: CO2 mineralization unit
definition: A unit that reacts CO2 with minerals or alkaline materials to form stable carbonates.

name: synthetic fuel CO2 conversion unit
definition: A unit that converts CO2 into fuels or chemical intermediates.

name: geological CO2 storage complex
definition: A subsurface storage system including storage reservoir, confining units, wells, monitoring systems and defined boundaries.

name: CO2 storage reservoir
definition: A geological formation intended to receive and contain injected carbon dioxide.

name: caprock seal
definition: A low-permeability geological unit that provides containment above or around a CO2 storage reservoir.

name: CO2 injection well
definition: A well used to inject carbon dioxide into a storage reservoir or EOR complex.

name: CO2 injection tree
definition: A wellhead/tree assembly used to control CO2 injection into a well.

name: CO2 monitoring well
definition: A well used to monitor pressure, fluid composition, plume movement or containment.

name: CO2 injection manifold
definition: A manifold used to distribute CO2 to one or more injection wells.

name: seismic monitoring system
definition: A system used to monitor subsurface CO2 plume movement or storage integrity using seismic methods.

name: pressure monitoring system
definition: A system used to monitor reservoir, well or annulus pressure during storage operations.

name: soil gas monitoring station
definition: A station used to detect or measure soil gas composition potentially associated with CO2 migration.

name: groundwater monitoring station
definition: A station or well used to monitor groundwater chemistry around a storage complex.

name: MRV system
definition: A monitoring, reporting and verification system used to quantify stored, emitted, leaked or transferred CO2.

name: CO2-EOR storage complex
definition: An EOR complex where CO2 is injected for enhanced hydrocarbon recovery and associated storage is quantified.

name: concept screening
definition: Information required to support CCUS concept screening, source-sink matching and feasibility.

name: post-injection monitoring duration

definition: A discipline addressing equipment reliability and planning required to maintain the equipment and other infrastructure. Includes procedures, spares, etc.

name: operations management
definition: A discipline related to the planning, scheduling and future operations management post turnover. Including but not limited to training materials, procedures, strategies, organization design, etc.

name: process engineering
definition: A discipline related to the design, operation, control, and optimization of chemical, physical, and biological processes. Including but not limited to process flow definition, process modeling, etc.

name: quality management
definition: A discipline addressing quality planning, assurance, control and improvement.

name: materials engineering
definition: A discipline addressing material selection and methods to manage integrity for the facility lifecycle, including corrosion management through coatings, linings, cathodic protection, inhibition, weld procedures, etc.

name: subsea engineering
definition: A discipline addressing design and control of production systems to be installed on the sea floor as well as any support equipment which tether those systems to a facility. Including but not limited to flowlines, wellheads, umbilicals, risers, etc.

name: ocean engineering
definition: A discipline addressing the collection and analysis of environmental conditions specific to offshore locations, including but not limited to metocean analysis, navigational analysis, ice studies, etc. Excludes structural design and loading.

name: commissioning
definition: A discipline covering the management of verification of installation, energization and testing of equipment.  May include but is not limited to multi-discipline procedures, etc.

name: CCUS basis of design
definition: Document defining project basis, boundaries, stream specifications, capture, transport and storage design assumptions.

name: CO2 mass balance
definition: Structured calculation showing captured, emitted, transferred, injected, stored and lost CO2 quantities.

name: carbon capture unit datasheet
definition: Datasheet for capture unit process capacity, efficiency, solvent, utilities and interface data.

name: solvent management datasheet
definition: Datasheet or register for solvent type, inventory, make-up, degradation and reclaiming requirements.

name: CO2 stream specification
definition: Specification of CO2 stream purity, phase, impurities, water content and custody transfer requirements.

name: CO2 dehydration package datasheet
definition: Datasheet for CO2 dehydration equipment, water content target and operating conditions.

name: CO2 compression train datasheet
definition: Datasheet for compressors, pumps, stages, suction/discharge conditions and utilities.

name: CO2 metering and allocation philosophy
definition: Document defining measurement, allocation, custody transfer and uncertainty requirements.

name: CO2 pipeline datasheet
definition: Datasheet for CO2 pipeline design pressure, phase, diameter, wall thickness, materials and route.

name: CO2 pipeline flow assurance study
definition: Study of CO2 phase behaviour, pressure, temperature, impurities, hydraulics and transient operations.

name: CO2 pipeline integrity management plan
definition: Plan defining integrity threats, inspection, fracture control, corrosion management and reassessment.

name: CO2 leak detection philosophy
definition: Document defining leak detection methods, alarm philosophy, monitoring coverage and response expectations.

name: CO2 dispersion study
definition: Study of CO2 release, dispersion, accumulation and exposure scenarios.

name: storage site characterization report
definition: Report documenting geological storage site screening, characterization and suitability.

name: CO2 reservoir simulation study
definition: Study modelling CO2 plume movement, pressure response, injectivity and storage capacity.

name: storage capacity assessment
definition: Assessment of static, dynamic or permitted storage capacity.

name: CO2 injection strategy
definition: Document defining injection rates, pressures, wells, constraints and ramp-up strategy.

name: CO2 injection well datasheet
definition: Datasheet for injection well design, materials, completion, tree and operating envelope.

name: well integrity assessment
definition: Assessment of injection or monitoring well integrity for CO2 service.

name: caprock integrity assessment
definition: Assessment of caprock seal capacity, integrity and containment risk.

name: MRV plan
definition: Monitoring, reporting and verification plan for injected, stored, emitted, transferred or leaked CO2.

name: MRV report
definition: Report documenting monitored data, quantified stored CO2, emissions, losses and verification outcomes.

name: monitoring data register
definition: Structured register of monitoring wells, instruments, seismic surveys, pressure data and environmental monitoring.

name: CCUS risk assessment
definition: Assessment of capture, transport, injection, storage, leakage, environmental and stakeholder risks.

name: CCUS permit register
definition: Register of permits, approvals, obligations, conditions and reporting deadlines.

name: storage closure and post-injection plan
definition: Plan for cessation of injection, closure, post-injection monitoring and stewardship.

name: CO2-EOR storage quantification report
definition: Report quantifying associated storage in a CO2-EOR project.

name: CO2 utilization unit datasheet
definition: Datasheet for CO2 utilization process capacity, conversion efficiency and product carbon retention assumptions.

name: CCUS operating procedure
definition: Procedure covering start-up, normal operation, shutdown, upset, venting, injection and emergency response.

name: CCUS operations and maintenance manual
definition: Manual describing operations, maintenance, inspection and troubleshooting of CCUS facilities.

name: CO2 source-sink interface agreement
definition: Agreement defining carbon dioxide quantity, quality, pressure, custody, availability, measurement, nomination and responsibility at source, hub, transport and storage interfaces.

name: CO2 impurity management plan
definition: Plan defining allowed impurity envelopes, upset handling, commingling controls, sampling, off-specification response and materials/phase-behaviour considerations.

name: CO2 shipping and terminal basis of design
definition: Basis of design for liquefaction, buffer storage, marine transfer, cargo conditions, terminal operations and carrier interfaces.

name: liquid CO2 storage system datasheet
definition: Datasheet for liquid carbon dioxide storage capacity, pressure, temperature, refrigeration, insulation, relief and transfer duty.

name: CO2 carrier interface specification
definition: Specification of cargo condition, transfer rate, loading arm, emergency release, vapour return, custody transfer and communications interfaces between terminal and carrier.

name: CCUS commissioning and performance test report
definition: Report recording commissioning, functional testing, capture performance, metering verification, transport readiness and injection/storage acceptance results.

name: CO2 emergency response plan
definition: Plan defining detection, isolation, depressurization, dispersion, evacuation, rescue, communications and recovery actions for carbon dioxide releases.

name: storage monitoring baseline report
definition: Report establishing pre-injection geological, pressure, seismic, groundwater, soil-gas, atmospheric and environmental baseline conditions.

name: storage pressure management plan
definition: Plan defining pressure constraints, brine production, treatment/disposal, monitoring, trigger levels and corrective actions for storage pressure management.

name: storage corrective measures plan
definition: Plan defining detection thresholds, investigation, remediation and verification actions for leakage, migration, well-integrity or containment concerns.

name: storage liability transfer dossier
definition: Dossier of closure evidence, post-injection monitoring, conformance, liabilities, records and approvals required for transfer of responsibility where applicable.

name: CO2 utilization carbon-accounting report
definition: Report quantifying carbon input, conversion, product allocation, emissions, permanence and eligible retained carbon for a utilization pathway.

name: CCUS equipment class
definition: A class of equipment, systems or subsurface assets used for carbon dioxide capture, conditioning, utilization, transportation, injection, storage, monitoring, verification or reporting.
aliases: carbon capture utilization and storage systems
searchText: CCUS projects require cross-domain classes not represented explicitly in the core RDL.

name: CCUS facility
definition: An integrated facility or asset system used to capture, condition, transport, use, inject, store or monitor carbon dioxide.
searchText: Abstract enterprise boundary for an integrated CCUS development, facility or asset context.

name: carbon capture plant
definition: A plant that separates carbon dioxide from a gas stream for compression, transport, utilization or storage.

name: post-combustion capture unit
definition: A carbon capture unit that separates CO2 from flue gas after combustion.

name: pre-combustion capture unit
definition: A carbon capture unit that removes CO2 from synthesis gas or shifted gas before combustion.

name: oxyfuel capture unit
definition: A carbon capture unit based on combustion in oxygen-rich conditions to produce a CO2-rich exhaust stream.

name: direct air capture unit
definition: A capture unit that removes CO2 directly from ambient air.

name: membrane CO2 separation unit
definition: A capture unit using membranes to separate CO2 from a gas stream.

name: adsorption CO2 capture unit
definition: A capture unit using adsorption media and cyclic regeneration to separate CO2.

name: CO2 absorber column
definition: A column where CO2 is absorbed from a gas stream into a solvent or other capture medium.

name: CO2 stripper column
definition: A column where captured CO2 is released from solvent or capture medium by regeneration.

name: solvent reboiler
definition: A heat exchanger that provides heat for solvent regeneration in a carbon capture process.

name: solvent reclaiming package
definition: A package that removes degradation products, contaminants or heat-stable salts from capture solvent.

name: solvent storage tank
definition: A tank used to store capture solvent or solvent make-up chemicals.

name: flue gas conditioning unit
definition: Equipment used to condition gas before CO2 capture, including cooling, particulate removal or contaminant control.

name: CO2 dehydration package
definition: A package that removes water from a CO2 stream to meet transport, corrosion or storage specifications.
searchText: CO2 conditioning and corrosion control class.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 conditioning and compression system

name: CO2 compression train
definition: A compression train that increases CO2 stream pressure for transport, injection or utilization.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 conditioning and compression system

name: CO2 compressor
definition: A compressor intended to increase pressure of carbon dioxide stream.

name: CO2 pump
definition: A pump used to move dense-phase or liquid carbon dioxide.

name: CO2 metering station
definition: A station that measures CO2 flow quantity, quality, pressure, temperature or composition for allocation, custody transfer or reporting.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 conditioning and compression system

name: CO2 analyzer package
definition: An analyzer package that measures CO2 purity, contaminants, water content or composition.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 conditioning and compression system

name: CO2 pipeline system
definition: A pipeline system used to transport CO2 streams between capture, utilization or storage facilities.

name: onshore CO2 pipeline
definition: A CO2 pipeline located onshore.

name: offshore CO2 pipeline
definition: A CO2 pipeline located offshore or subsea.

name: CO2 block valve station
definition: A station containing valves used to isolate sections of a CO2 pipeline.

name: CO2 vent station
definition: A station or facility used to vent, depressurize or safely dispose of CO2 from a system.
searchText: CO2 pipeline safety and operations class.

name: CO2 shipping terminal
definition: A terminal used to load, unload, buffer or condition carbon dioxide for marine transport.

name: liquid CO2 storage tank
definition: A storage tank used for temporary storage of liquefied carbon dioxide.

name: CO2 ship loading arm
definition: Equipment used to transfer carbon dioxide between terminal and ship.

name: CO2 utilization unit
definition: A unit that uses carbon dioxide as a feedstock or reactant in a downstream process.

name: CO2 mineralization unit
definition: A unit that reacts CO2 with minerals or alkaline materials to form stable carbonates.

name: synthetic fuel CO2 conversion unit
definition: A unit that converts CO2 into fuels or chemical intermediates.

name: geological CO2 storage complex
definition: A subsurface storage system including storage reservoir, confining units, wells, monitoring systems and defined boundaries.
searchText: Represents the governed geological storage boundary including reservoir, confining units, wells and monitoring network.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 storage and injection system

name: CO2 storage reservoir
definition: A geological formation intended to receive and contain injected carbon dioxide.

name: caprock seal
definition: A low-permeability geological unit that provides containment above or around a CO2 storage reservoir.

name: CO2 injection well
definition: A well used to inject carbon dioxide into a storage reservoir or EOR complex.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 storage and injection system

name: CO2 injection tree
definition: A wellhead/tree assembly used to control CO2 injection into a well.

name: CO2 monitoring well
definition: A well used to monitor pressure, fluid composition, plume movement or containment.

name: CO2 injection manifold
definition: A manifold used to distribute CO2 to one or more injection wells.

name: seismic monitoring system
definition: A system used to monitor subsurface CO2 plume movement or storage integrity using seismic methods.

name: pressure monitoring system
definition: A system used to monitor reservoir, well or annulus pressure during storage operations.

name: soil gas monitoring station
definition: A station used to detect or measure soil gas composition potentially associated with CO2 migration.

name: groundwater monitoring station
definition: A station or well used to monitor groundwater chemistry around a storage complex.

name: MRV system
definition: A monitoring, reporting and verification system used to quantify stored, emitted, leaked or transferred CO2.
searchText: Provides the integrated monitoring, reporting and verification system boundary for measured and calculated CCUS performance.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 monitoring and verification system

name: CO2-EOR storage complex
definition: An EOR complex where CO2 is injected for enhanced hydrocarbon recovery and associated storage is quantified.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 storage and injection system

name: CO2 capture system
definition: Abstract classification for source-gas conditioning, carbon dioxide separation and capture-process equipment and packages.
searchText: Groups capture technologies and supporting capture-process classes within the CCUS hierarchy.

name: CO2 conditioning and compression system
definition: Abstract classification for carbon dioxide purification, dehydration, compression, pumping, metering, aggregation and liquefaction systems.
searchText: Groups transport-preparation and pressure-management equipment between capture and transport or storage interfaces.

name: CO2 transportation system
definition: Abstract classification for pipeline and marine systems used to transport carbon dioxide between source, hub, utilization and storage facilities.
searchText: Groups onshore, offshore and ship-based carbon dioxide transportation classes.

name: CO2 utilization system
definition: Abstract classification for systems that convert, incorporate or otherwise use carbon dioxide as a feedstock or process input.
searchText: Separates utilization technologies from capture, transport and storage classes.

name: CO2 storage and injection system
definition: Abstract classification for geological storage complexes, injection facilities, wells, pressure-management systems and related subsurface assets.
searchText: Groups injection and geological storage concepts requiring subsurface and well-governance semantics.

name: CO2 monitoring and verification system
definition: Abstract classification for monitoring, measurement, reporting, verification and environmental surveillance systems associated with CCUS.
searchText: Groups monitoring and verification classes spanning capture, transport and storage boundaries.

name: CO2 source aggregation hub
definition: A facility that receives carbon dioxide from multiple source facilities, manages stream compatibility, meters and conditions the combined stream for onward transport.
searchText: Multi-source CCUS networks require an explicit aggregation and interface-management class.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 conditioning and compression system

name: CO2 liquefaction package
definition: A package that cools and condenses carbon dioxide to specified liquid storage or marine-transport conditions.
searchText: Ship-based transport requires dedicated liquefaction and refrigeration information not represented by generic compression alone.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 conditioning and compression system

name: CO2 carrier vessel
definition: A marine vessel designed or converted to transport liquefied carbon dioxide between terminals.
searchText: Marine carbon dioxide transport requires vessel-level cargo, containment, transfer and safety information.

name: CO2 pipeline booster station
definition: A station containing compressors or pumps used to maintain the pressure and flow of carbon dioxide in a transport network.
searchText: Long-distance or networked transport may require intermediate pressure boosting.

name: CO2 pipeline pigging station
definition: A station containing pig launch, receive, isolation and handling equipment for inspection, cleaning or commissioning of a carbon dioxide pipeline.
aliases: CO2 pig launcher and receiver station
searchText: Pipeline integrity and commissioning require explicit pigging facilities.

name: CO2 surface injection facility
definition: A surface facility that receives, meters, conditions and distributes carbon dioxide to one or more injection wells.
searchText: Separates surface injection and well-distribution functions from the geological storage complex.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 storage and injection system

name: CO2 pressure management well
definition: A well used to produce brine or otherwise manage formation pressure in support of carbon dioxide storage operations.
searchText: Some storage developments require active pressure-management assets distinct from injection and monitoring wells.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 storage and injection system

name: atmospheric CO2 monitoring station
definition: A station used to measure atmospheric carbon dioxide concentration, meteorology or dispersion indicators around a CCUS facility or storage site.
searchText: Near-surface monitoring may require dedicated atmospheric surveillance assets.

name: storage site monitoring network
definition: An integrated network of wells, sensors, surveys and environmental stations used to establish baseline conditions and monitor plume, pressure and containment performance.
searchText: Storage monitoring is an integrated network rather than a single instrument or report.
secondaryLabel: Parent: CO2 monitoring and verification system

name: CO2 emergency depressurization system
definition: A controlled system used to isolate, depressurize and discharge carbon dioxide inventory during planned or emergency conditions.
searchText: Dense-phase and liquefied carbon dioxide systems require explicit depressurization and dispersion controls.

name: concept screening
definition: Information required to support CCUS concept screening, source-sink matching and feasibility.

name: storage site selection
definition: Information required to support storage site selection, characterization planning and permitting basis.

name: basis for design freeze
definition: Information required at CCUS basis for design freeze.

name: capture package award
definition: Vendor data required at capture, dehydration, compression or analyzer package award.

name: pipeline and storage design freeze
definition: Transport, injection, storage and MRV design data required at design freeze.

name: ready for injection
definition: Information required before CO2 injection or storage operations commence.

name: commissioning complete
definition: Commissioning, performance, metering and system acceptance information.

name: operations handover
definition: Final operational, monitoring, permit and MRV information required for operations handover.

name: cessation of injection
definition: Information required when injection stops and closure/post-injection monitoring begins.

name: storage closure evidence accepted
definition: Information required to demonstrate closure conformance, post-injection monitoring completion and readiness for transfer of responsibility where applicable.

name: capture design and performance data
definition: Capture technology, source-gas basis, inlet flow and composition, capture rate, efficiency, energy use and emissions-performance data.

name: flue-gas conditioning design data
definition: Source-gas contaminants, cooling, particulate removal, SOx/NOx control and capture-interface operating data.

name: CO2 conditioning and quality data
definition: CO2 composition, water content, phase, dew point, contaminants, pressure, temperature and off-specification handling data.

name: CO2 compression and pumping data
definition: Compression stages, suction/discharge conditions, power, cooling, minimum design temperature and operating envelope.

name: CO2 metering and allocation data
definition: Metering basis, uncertainty, quality measurement, allocation factor, calibration and custody-transfer information.

name: CO2 pipeline design and integrity data
definition: Mass flow, phase envelope, pressure/temperature, route, diameter, wall thickness, fracture control, corrosion and leak-detection data.

name: CO2 shipping and terminal data
definition: Cargo condition, buffer capacity, storage pressure/temperature, transfer rate, carrier and emergency-interface data.

name: CO2 source aggregation hub data
definition: Source ownership, nomination, quantity, quality, commingling compatibility, allocation and interface responsibilities.

name: CO2 liquefaction and buffer-storage data
definition: Liquefaction duty, refrigeration, cargo condition, storage capacity, transfer rate and boil-off/vent handling data.

name: CO2 surface injection system data
definition: Receipt quality, metering, injection distribution, rates, pressures, operating envelope and well interface data.

name: CO2 injection well design and integrity data
definition: Well completion, barrier philosophy, materials, maximum injection pressure, injectivity, annulus surveillance and integrity status.

name: geological storage characterization data
definition: Storage type, capacity, reservoir depth, thickness, area, pressure, temperature, porosity, permeability, salinity, caprock and containment-risk data.

name: storage monitoring system data
definition: Baseline status, monitoring methods, frequency, plume footprint, pressure, environmental stations, trigger levels and data-management information.

name: MRV and quantification data
definition: Stored mass, leakage/loss, allocation, measurement boundaries, uncertainty, monitoring evidence and reporting-period data.

name: storage pressure management data
definition: Pressure limits, management need, selected method, brine rate, treatment/disposal, monitoring and corrective trigger data.

name: CO2 utilization and permanence data
definition: Product type, conversion efficiency, carbon input/output, allocation, emissions and permanence/retention category.

name: CO2 emergency depressurization data
definition: Isolation boundary, inventory, depressurization rate, minimum temperature, discharge location, dispersion basis and emergency response actions.

name: storage permitting and closure data
definition: Permit status, obligations, monitoring period, closure readiness, corrective measures and liability-transfer evidence.

name: CO2 transport operational data
definition: Normal and transient operating envelope, nomination, line pack, isolation, pigging, venting and restart data.

name: capture commissioning and performance data
definition: Performance-test basis, guaranteed capacity/efficiency, utilities, emissions, solvent consumption and acceptance results.

name: CO2 capture rate
definition: Mass flow rate of CO2 captured by a capture facility.

name: CO2 capture efficiency
definition: Fraction of incoming CO2 captured by the capture process.

name: CO2 avoided emissions
definition: Mass of CO2 emissions avoided relative to a defined baseline.

name: specific energy consumption for capture
definition: Energy consumed per unit mass of CO2 captured.

name: capture technology
definition: Technology family used to capture CO2.

name: solvent type
definition: Solvent or capture medium used in a solvent-based capture process.

name: solvent circulation rate
definition: Volumetric flow rate of capture solvent.

name: solvent degradation rate
definition: Rate at which capture solvent degrades or requires make-up.

name: reboiler duty
definition: Thermal duty required for solvent regeneration.

name: CO2 purity
definition: Mole fraction or volume fraction of CO2 in the CO2 stream.

name: CO2 water content
definition: Water content in the CO2 stream.

name: CO2 oxygen content
definition: Oxygen content in a CO2 stream.

name: CO2 H2S content
definition: Hydrogen sulphide content in a CO2 stream.

name: CO2 stream phase
definition: Thermodynamic phase of the transported or injected CO2 stream.

name: CO2 density
definition: Density of the CO2 stream at specified conditions.

name: CO2 dew point temperature
definition: Temperature at which water or hydrocarbon condensation can occur in the CO2 stream.

name: CO2 compression ratio
definition: Ratio of compressor discharge pressure to suction pressure.

name: CO2 suction pressure
definition: Pressure at compressor or pump suction.

name: CO2 discharge pressure
definition: Pressure at compressor or pump discharge.

name: CO2 discharge temperature
definition: Temperature of CO2 at compressor or pump discharge.

name: pipeline design pressure
definition: Design pressure of a CO2 pipeline.

name: pipeline operating pressure
definition: Operating pressure of a CO2 pipeline.

name: pipeline design temperature
definition: Design temperature of a CO2 pipeline.

name: pipeline diameter
definition: Nominal or outside diameter of a CO2 pipeline.

name: pipeline wall thickness
definition: Wall thickness of a CO2 pipeline.

name: fracture control requirement
definition: Indicates whether fracture propagation control is required for a CO2 pipeline.

name: internal corrosion allowance
definition: Corrosion allowance for internal corrosion in CO2 service.

name: CO2 leak detection required
definition: Indicates whether CO2 leak detection is required.

name: CO2 leak detection method
definition: Method used to detect CO2 leakage.

name: CO2 storage type
definition: Type of geological or associated storage.

name: storage capacity
definition: Estimated mass of CO2 that can be stored in a storage reservoir or complex.

name: dynamic storage capacity
definition: Estimated storage capacity under dynamic injection and pressure constraints.

name: annual injection rate
definition: Mass of CO2 injected per year.

name: maximum injection pressure
definition: Maximum allowed pressure at wellhead or reservoir reference point for CO2 injection.

name: reservoir pressure
definition: Pressure in the storage reservoir.

name: reservoir temperature
definition: Temperature in the storage reservoir.

name: reservoir porosity
definition: Fraction of rock volume that is pore space.

name: reservoir permeability
definition: Measure of the ability of the reservoir to transmit fluids.

name: caprock integrity status
definition: Assessment status of the caprock seal integrity.

name: plume monitoring method
definition: Method used to monitor CO2 plume location or movement.

name: monitoring frequency
definition: Frequency of required monitoring activity.

name: stored CO2 mass
definition: Mass of CO2 stored or quantified as stored.

name: CO2 leakage rate
definition: Rate of CO2 leakage or loss from a defined boundary.

name: CO2 allocation factor
definition: Allocation factor used to assign stored CO2 to sources, streams or ownership.

name: MRV plan required
definition: Indicates whether a monitoring, reporting and verification plan is required.

name: storage permit status
definition: Status of storage permit or authorization.

name: closure readiness status
definition: Status of preparation for storage site closure or termination.

name: post-injection monitoring duration

It has excellent fatigue resistance and good machinability. It is used for aircraft structures, rivets, truck wheels, screw machine products, etc.16

name: AL 356

name: AL 5052
definition: An aluminum alloy with magnesium as the primary alloying element, supplemented with a small chromium addition. It has good corrosion resistance, especially to seawater and salt water. It also has good weldability and formability. It is used for marine applications, fuel tanks, electronic chassis, etc.22

name: AL 5083
definition: An aluminum alloy with magnesium and traces of manganese and chromium as the primary alloying elements. It has high strength and excellent corrosion resistance in marine environments. It also has good weldability and low-temperature performance. It is used for shipbuilding, cryogenic tanks, railway cars, etc.23

name: AL 5086

name: AL 5254

name: AL 5454

name: AL 5652

It also has good machinability and weldability. It is used for aircraft components, automotive parts, construction materials, etc.30

It also has good formability and weldability. It is used for window frames, door frames, pipes, tubes, furniture, etc.31

name: project management and engineering
definition: A macro discipline covering the administrative and management related items associated with a major capital project, including organization, cross-engineering discipline philosophies, basis of design, regulatory activities, etc.

name: construction
definition: A macro discipline covering the specification and management of field installation and hook up of facilities.  May includes but is not limited to installation, transportation, fabrication, construction and mechanical completion related information.

name: architectural engineering
definition: A civil engineering specialty addressing the design of buildings meant for occupancy.

name: geotechnical engineering
definition: A civil engineering specialty addressing the engineering behaviors of earth materials.

name: infrastructure engineering
definition: A civil engineering specialty addressing systems necessary to support a site, including but not limited to roads, ports, sewer, utilities, and power.

name: structural engineering
definition: A civil engineering specialty addressing the design of structures which resist loads, specifically constructed of concrete and steel.

name: civil engineering
definition: A discipline addressing the design and maintenance of earthworks, including but not limited to levees, berms, grade, and drainage.

name: electrical engineering
definition: A discipline addressing the design and application of circuitry and equipment for power generation and distribution

name: cost and planning management
definition: A discipline addressing the management of project cost and schedule, involving such activities as estimating, cost control, cost and schedule forecasting, investment appraisal and risk analysis

name: environmental
definition: A discipline addressing the interface between capital project and the natural environment, specifically addressing risk analysis and mitigation to impact to air, water, flora and fauna.

name: health
definition: A discipline addressing the health and welfare of personnel engaged in work or employment

name: security
definition: A discipline addressing assessment of condition, analysis of risk and mitigation of potential harm to physical assets from external forces.

name: safety
definition: A discipline addressing assessment of condition, analysis of risk and mitigation of potential harm to personnel as a result of their working conditions or behaviors

name: health, safety, environmental and security
definition: A macro discipline used to classify content generally addressing a combination of 'safety', 'security', 'health' and 'environmental', or any combination thereof.

name: instrumentation engineering
definition: A discipline addressing the design and application of monitoring and control systems.

name: information management
definition: A discipline addressing the collection and management of information both in document and data formats

name: information technology
definition: A discipline addressing internal networks, security, and equipment to store, retrieve, transmit and manipulate data at a facility, etc.  Specifically excluded facility control systems.

name: pipeline engineering
definition: A discipline addressing the systems that are used to transport liquids and gases. Including but not limited to pipeline design hydraulics, routes & stability,specification and other accessories such as cathodic protection, pigging equipment etc.

name: heating, ventilating, and air conditioning
definition: A mechanical engineering specialty addressing the design and application of systems for heating, ventilation, and/or air-conditioning (HVAC)

name: piping engineering
definition: A mechanical engineering specialty addressing the design, routing, and control of flow inside process and utilities via piping and related specialty equipment

name: mechanical rotating engineering
definition: A mechanical engineering specialty addressing mechanical components used to add kinetic energy to any process in order to make a material move. The equipment may include pumps, turbines, gearboxes, compressors, engines, etc.

name: mechanical static engineering
definition: A mechanical engineering specialty addressing mechanical equipment with no rotating components.  The equipment may include tanks, vessels, heat exchangers, and fired equipment such as furnaces and boilers.

name: mechanical engineering
definition: A macro discipline used to classify content generally addressing a combination of 'piping', HVAC, 'rotating', or 'static equipment', or any combination thereof.

name: maintenance management
definition: A discipline addressing equipment reliability and planning required to maintain the equipment and other infrastructure. Includes procedures, spares, etc.

name: operations management
definition: A discipline related to the planning, scheduling and future operations management post turnover. Including but not limited to training materials, procedures, strategies, organization design, etc.

name: process engineering
definition: A discipline related to the design, operation, control, and optimization of chemical, physical, and biological processes. Including but not limited to process flow definition, process modeling, etc.

name: quality management
definition: A discipline addressing quality planning, assurance, control and improvement.

name: materials engineering
definition: A discipline addressing material selection and methods to manage integrity for the facility lifecycle, including corrosion management through coatings, linings, cathodic protection, inhibition, weld procedures, etc.

name: logistics management
definition: A discipline addressing the management of the transport, storage, distribution, and warehousing of materials and finished goods.  May also include transport and logistics of personnel, where applicable.

name: telecommunications
definition: A discipline addressing external communication systems.  This typically includes, any systems or equipment used for transmission of information across a distance, such as coax cable, optical fiber, radio, dish, etc.

name: subsea engineering
definition: A discipline addressing design and control of production systems to be installed on the sea floor as well as any support equipment which tether those systems to a facility. Including but not limited to flowlines, wellheads, umbilicals, risers, etc.

name: contracting and procurement management
definition: A discipline addressing management of contractual development and administration, as well as procurement of finished goods from third parties.

name: ocean engineering
definition: A discipline addressing the collection and analysis of environmental conditions specific to offshore locations, including but not limited to metocean analysis, navigational analysis, ice studies, etc. Excludes structural design and loading.

name: commissioning
definition: A discipline covering the management of verification of installation, energization and testing of equipment.  May include but is not limited to multi-discipline procedures, etc.

name: action list
definition: A collection of activities tracking responsible parties and status, including but not limited to punch lists, issues lists, and check lists.

name: active fire protection system specification
definition: Design data and information that forms the basis of the performance specification for the active fire fighting systems (manual, foam, monitor, deluge/sprinkler systems etc.).

name: alarm, trip setting list
definition: A collection of all instrument set points and/or alarms.  Each instrument having an alarm or trip function is listed. Alarms and settings are given as percentages of transmitter range and in engineering units, together with transmitter range, location of the annunciation point, cabinet, identification and relevant P&IDs/PEFS or logic drawing.

name: anchoring diagram
definition: A diagram showing anchoring and mooring of offshore vessels and structures and the interaction of anchor lines with sub-sea pipelines and structures.

name: anchoring study
definition: Includes anchoring of offshore vessels and the interaction of anchor lines with sub-sea pipelines and structures.

name: applicable standards list
definition: A collection of all applicable company standards, international, national and industry codes & standards that are referenced in the company standards and project specific specifications.

name: application software
definition: A computer program designed for a specific task or use.

name: approval certificate
definition: A document issued by a recognised independent authority certifying the equipment has been manufactured in accordance with code/standard. Type approval certificates are normally acceptable for proprietary items. CE mark certification or similar equivalent shall be included under this document type.

name: approved vendor list
definition: A collection of approved vendors and suppliers for a particular contract.

name: aspect data
definition: Data which further describes an element of an organisation's activities, products or services that can interact with the environment. Enhances 'aspect register'.

name: assembly diagram
definition: A diagram utilized for transient activity during assembly (e.g. sequence of activity) and not finished work.

name: asset reference plan
definition: An integrated lifecycle management and development plan for surface and sub-surface facilities, including development scenarios, and phased development plans.

name: assurance plan
definition: A plan assuring that standards of quality are being met by systematically monitoring and evaluating the various aspects of deliverables vs standards.  Predecessor to 'document distribution matrix'.

name: dispersion study
definition: A document detailing the dispersion of atmospheric releases from flaring, venting, and exhaust from compressors and machinery as well as dispersion of leaks to ground or water.

name: audit plan
definition: A document capturing what particular audits and assessments will be carried out to achieve the overall quality program.  May include an overview schedule highlighting activities.

name: authority matrix
definition: A list or register of people or organisations authorised to perform a range of tasks which may be technical, financial, contractual, organisational, or other. Includes Technical Authorities Matrix, Roles and Responsibilities, RACI/RASCI.

name: basis of design
definition: A document outlining the premise for decisions and the resulting principles that are to be followed regarding the design of the facility and comprising all process design philosophies including but not limited to environmental, drainage, ventilation, spading/isolation, plant availability/down time assessment and relief/blowdown philosophy etc.

name: basis of estimate
definition: A document outlining the premise for decisions and the resulting principles that are to be followed regarding estimates. This document should be updated with each formal update of the project cost estimate, particularly at each stage gate. As much detail as possible should be provided in the document, relative to the scope definition available for the compilation of the estimate.

name: feasibility study
definition: A document assessing the practicality and/or economics of a proposed solution.

name: benchmarking data
definition: A data set used to evaluate or judge project estimates and or performance relative to it (i.e., ISO 19008).

name: bill of materials
definition: A list of all parts and sub assemblies that constitute a particular assembly, showing the quantity of each required item. Typically developed from analyzing a drawing.

name: bill of quantities
definition: A consolidated list of assemblies or bulk material showing the quantity of each required to suit a purpose. Use 'bill of materials' for sub assemblies and parts.

name: three dimensional model review report
definition: A report documenting the review results from 3D review addressing steelwork structure, equipment envelopes, escape routes, building envelopes, envelopes for main piping, HVAC and cable rack runs, preliminary road layouts, etc.

name: cable schedule
definition: A collection of values relating to List of all cables, their specifications and end points. Indicates salient features of all cables in Vendor's supply and connecting cables supplied by Principal.

name: cable size calculation
definition: Calculations required for sizing of cables.

name: capital spares study
definition: A consolidated study reviewing critical equipment and recommending capital spares.

name: cathodic protection diagram
definition: A diagram showing locations of cathodic protection and schematic diagrams.

name: change control procedure
definition: A procedure describing how changes through 'design', 'construction' and 'commissioning' will be managed.

name: change control register
definition: A consolidated register of proposed and/or processed change associated with all change to originally agreed design scope/statement of requirements, including basis for design.

name: change notification
definition: An advance notice to another party, e.g. another design department or fabrication facility, that there is going to be a change to a document that has been issued for construction.

name: clarification request
definition: Request (e.g., from a Contractor) for clarification of scope, technical details, or assumptions.

name: commissioning and startup strategy
definition: A document outlining purpose and approach for commissioning and start-up.

name: communication procedure
definition: A cross-discipline, internal and external communication procedure, responsibilities, and governance.

name: connection diagram
definition: A diagram showing details of cable numbers and terminations point to point (e.g., to/from vendor packages, equipment).

name: construction diagram
definition: A diagram detailing assembly and fabrication.

name: construction schedule
definition: A time-based document outlining sequence and duration of activities related to the completion of construction scope.  Construction includes site erection and assembly but not fabrication at third party sites.

name: constructability study
definition: A document assessing sequence and method of construction of a facility to determine the best way to proceed.

name: contract
definition: A binding document which records a agreement and its related mutual obligations and commitments. Typically having effect on a project or the future life of a facility. For example a sales contract, maintenance contract, etc.

name: control philosophy
definition: A document outlining the premise and intent for start-up and shutdown for process control. May also list instrument and control equipment, pre-alarm and shutdown alarm/trip requirements, failure modes of valves and equipment and type of signals to and from the control logic. Basis to develop more detailed control narrative.

name: control system diagram
definition: A pictorial representation of the main elements and functions of a control circuit/system with input/output sources (switches, relays etc.) and their relationships. Details logic functions of the circuit/system. I/O loading and cabinet layouts.

name: corrective action report
definition: A report detailing actions to be taken to improve a process resulting from an 'audit' or 'quality assessment'.

name: correspondence
definition: Any form of written communication sent or received in the course of affairs including transmittals, letters, postcards, memoranda, electronic mail, facsimiles, telegrams or cables.

name: chemical selection report
definition: Detailed report from results of corrosion inhibition, hydrates, flow assurance, etc testing plan. Includes any preliminary testing required to establish parameters for testing.

name: chemical testing plan
definition: A document capturing parameters and requirements to validate selection of chemicals including but not limited to corrosion inhibitors, hydrate inhibitors, and  flow assurance chemicals.

name: cost control procedure
definition: A procedure for monitoring, controlling and reporting expenditures.

name: cost report
definition: A report of all costs incurred over a period of time.

name: cost time resource estimate report
definition: Estimate of resources (people and money) required to produce certain deliverables, typically associated with scope change. Often becomes the basis for an agreement or a contract.

name: regulatory compliance certificate
definition: A document certifying conformity to local regulations which accompanies shipment of equipment and/or goods. e.g., official certificate issued by OEM/supplier or approved licensed agent of OEM/supplier.

name: country regulation specific standard
definition: A specific standard documenting additional design, construction, work process, and documentation of plant as required by local regulations. This document type shall not be used to classify the engineering technical standards (e.g. API, ISO, etc.).

name: country regulation technical project documentation book
definition: A technical document describing the facilities that are proposed to be built in a country and includes all information required for regulatory approval to proceed. The document is submitted to the regulatory authorities for review and approval.

name: database and data set
definition: Data stored in a proprietary (e.g. SPI Watcom) or neutral (e.g. CSV) format from which multiple information contents can be generated by computer software (e.g. EDW). Includes '3D model'.

name: decommissioning plan
definition: A document capturing what particular activities and requirements will be executed and delivered to decommission and demolish (parts of) existing assets. This would include temporary assets required only for the life of the project, as well.

name: demonstration note on compliance
definition: A document that demonstrates that the design meets the process safety basic requirements with evidences and references to documents.

name: design calculation
definition: A calculations prepared in order to prove that the item of equipment or system selected meets the design criteria.

name: design cases study
definition: A document capturing model output defining the process design cases and sensitivity cases for process modelling.

name: design hse case
definition: A document outlining purpose and approach for a HSE design. Demonstrates ALARP.

name: design layout study
definition: A document assessing different physical configurations of a set of equipment and explaining the rationale supporting the adoption of a particular layout.

name: design philosophy
definition: A document outlining the premise and intent for decisions that are to be followed regarding a design. A set of ideas, beliefs, or underlying theory.

name: design review report
definition: A report documenting verification of a design, based on comparison with standards, constructability, operability, safety, etc. May be performed by internal or external resources.

name: discipline delivery plan
definition: A consolidated document describing discipline specific activities and deliverables and their criticality to drive appropriate review processes.  This is a starting point for document distribution matrix stating quality assurance and control requirements.

name: document distribution matrix
definition: A document providing an overview of distribution (workflow) process for information. Often a report out of a electronic document management system.

name: information requirements specification
definition: Specification of the Information types required by the owner for delivery and handover.

name: document, data control procedure
definition: A procedure specifically for document and data control ('information management'). Includes 'document control' charts and other procedure components.

name: master document register
definition: A register (at 'document', not 'document type' level) of the information delivered on the project, including all deliverables which receive a document number including but not limited to drawings, lists, applications, databases, and models provided by 'contractor' or 'vendor' to satisfy 'company' requirements.

name: drafting specification
definition: Rules and conventions for preparing drawings, including symbol lists, etc. may include drawing templates.

name: ducting and instrument diagram
definition: A schematic representation of an HVAC system indicating all HVAC equipment items and their control interfaces.  Abbreviation is typically D&ID.

name: earthing diagram
definition: A diagram detailing earthing (grounding) for plant and equipment and between modules and dissimilar structural elements.

name: emergency exits diagram
definition: A diagram detailing escape routes, means of emergency escape/egress.

name: emergency response procedure
definition: A procedure detailing how the facility would respond to an emergency and how personnel would be able to evacuate. As defined for 'facilities operations' and for 'pipeline operations'.

name: emissions report
definition: A report detailing accumulated environmental emissions over a set period of time.

name: engineering schedule
definition: A time-based document outlining order in which tasks are to be carried out and the amounts of time allocated to them.  Addresses design phase as well as engineering support during manufacturing, construction, tie-in, test/inspect, shutdown.

name: environmental impact assessment
definition: An assessment which details the impact of facility on the surrounding environment.

name: regulatory compliance report
definition: Report demonstrating compliance with local regulations and law.

name: environmental management system description
definition: Shall include a brief description of 'vendor's' documented 'environmental management system' showing how the system is structured and reference to the standard on which it is based (e.g. ISO 14001 or similar).

name: equipment production criticality rating report
definition: A report documenting production criticality rating of equipment, sparing, maintenance testing and inspection requirements, spare parts requirements etc. Will feed into maintenance reference plan.

name: equipment cross section diagram
definition: A sliced view of a part or component that shows its internal make up.

name: design datasheet
definition: A datasheet which provides precise information about a  tag and compliments equipment specification.

name: general diagram
definition: A diagram not otherwise described in another document type.  Not to be used if a more specific document type can be used.  Can be used for singular/specialty deliverables which do not have a unique document type.

name: installation diagram
definition: Installation refers to the mounting, setting, erection, etc. of equipment and accessories. These diagrams are for transient activity during installation (eg. sequence of activity) and not finished work.

name: master tag-equipment register
definition: An authoritative collection of values with a relationship to a specific equipment or tag.  The columns of this collection is specified and controlled.

name: equipment list
definition: A customized list developed to support discipline activities, extract from a Register that is used as a secondary reference (i.e. not the master). Considers all potential disciplines. Covers: conduits, panels, pipe supports, piping speciality items, lighting, etc.

name: equipment type selection philosophy
definition: A document outlining the premise and intent for decisions that are to be followed regarding a selection of rotating equipment. Typically provided as instruction from 'owner operator'.

name: escape, evacuation, rescue assessment
definition: An assessment which details the emergency evacuation and rescue means from a facility.

name: expediting report
definition: A report of all open purchase orders containing items scheduled to be received as of a given date, but not yet received.

name: fabrication schedule
definition: A time-based document outlining sequence and duration of activities related to the completion of fabrication scope at third party sites.

name: fatigue analysis
definition: Verification of module/substructure design for cyclic loads.

name: floor plan
definition: A diagram showing building, rooms, doorways, cabinet and other permanent equipment installed.

name: field development plan
definition: A plan providing an evaluation of field development alternatives together with the selection of an optimal development concept based on subsurface scenarios (uncertainty) and field engineering options.

name: finite element analysis report
definition: A report documenting method (including software) and results of finite element analysis of components.

name: fire extinguishant calculation
definition: Calculations to prove that a given quantity of agent will be delivered at a set rate & time. Note: Applicable to fixed fire suppression systems designed specifically for room protection.  Water mist will also be used for turbine enclosure protection.

name: fire protection philosophy
definition: A document outlining the premise and intent for  fire protection both passive (firewalls) and active (manual, foam, monitor, deluge/sprinkler systems etc.) in a facility.

name: fire, explosion assessment
definition: An assessment which details the fire and explosion propagation and risks based on facility design.

name: fluid analysis
definition: A report documenting compositional lab analysis of fluid streams.

name: heat treatment procedure
definition: A procedure detailing heating, soak, cooling parameters, limits of strain during forming, temperature ranges, method of attachment of thermocouples, temperature control, equipment calibration, production testing, etc.

name: foundation design diagram
definition: Details of foundation design for construction. Also see 'foundation loading diagram', specifically for loads and 'foundation layout diagram', specifically for spatial location.

name: foundation loading diagram
definition: A diagram detailing static and dynamic forces or movements acting on foundations or other load bearing supports, anchor bolt details, lengths and pre-tensioning. May include 'civil structural' for loads imposed, and 'civil foundations' for foundation design.  Also see 'foundation design diagram', specifically for construction details.

name: general arrangement diagram
definition: A diagram showing the main features and locations of major items. Usually has some dimensions to convey spatial relationships but is generally inadequate for construction.

name: handling, shipping, storage procedure
definition: A procedure indicate size of container, number off, weight, identification and contents, include detail preservation procedure detailing inspection periods, materials required etc., both prior to installation and post installation, but prior to commissioning.  Any special unpacking/handling requirements shall be stated.

name: hazard analysis
definition: A report identifying hazards following review exercises.

name: hazard identification report
definition: A report summarizing all project (HAZID) exercises. Usually includes action lists, follow up, and close out action descriptions and acceptance.

name: hazard and operability report
definition: A report summarizing all project HAZOP studies. To include action lists, follow up and close out action descriptions and acceptance.

name: hazard, effect register
definition: An authoritative collection of all individual point sources for emissions, discharge inventories and corresponding zone classifications. The columns of this collection are specified and controlled.

name: hazardous area certificate
definition: A document issued by a recognised independent authority certifying that a type test has satisfied the specified standards; e.g.  ATEX, BASEEFA, PTB, UL, CSA, etc. Examples of ratings include 'intrinsically safe & explosion proof'.

name: hazardous area classification diagram
definition: A diagram which provides information on the level of explosion proofing etc. required in each area.

name: health impact assessment
definition: An assessment which details the impact of facility on the health of the surrounding populace.

name: heat and mass balance summary
definition: A report detailing heat & mass balance for an individual design case. It will contain all required process compositions and parameters for selected locations through the process.

name: hook up diagram
definition: A diagram which may show the instrument impulse, pneumatic and electronic connections, pipe work, valves, fittings, flanges and support details with associated material take-off list. Used for removal/hook up purposes and modifications.

name: hvac flow diagram
definition: A schematic diagram depicting an HVAC ducting system, including all items of duct mounted equipment complete with tag numbers, flow rate and duct sizing information.

name: hydraulic calculation
definition: Calculations to indicate basis on which equipment is sized, including pipe friction losses, equipment elevations and terminal point static pressures. Includes 'net positive suction head' calculations and other steady state conditions. Also includes calculation of hydraulic surge (synonym 'water hammer') for the purpose of determining valve sizing, closing speed, etc.

name: hydraulic, pneumatic diagram
definition: A schematic for any system not covered by PEFS/UEFS (e.g., P&IDs) e.g. hydraulic pneumatic cooling,  hydraulic controls.

name: ice analysis study
definition: A study providing an analysis of ice data.

name: ice environment reference document study
definition: A study providing a description of the ice environment.

name: ice survey
definition: A report describing how, when and where ice data has been collected.

name: safety critical elements register
definition: An authoritative collection of all safety critical elements (SCE), as defined by company.  The columns of this collection are specified and controlled.

name: in place analysis
definition: A report documenting  assumptions and method determining computer structural analysis for topsides modules including piperack, flare tower, bridge for in-place loading condition.

name: incident report
definition: A report issued to achieve timely notification report of any accident incident occurring during the projects, including on-site, in contractors offices, etc. Severity requirements to be specified by 'owner/operator'.

name: independent assessment
definition: An assessment which is generated by 3rd party technical or execution expert on work done in their relevant field to assess correctness of approach/deliverable.

name: index of documents
definition: Books, as defined in the CFIHOS require this Index to be created. Since the purpose of the 'index' is management of a group of documents, this can only be associated with JA 'information management'. Examples: 'health', 'safety', 'environment', 'quality communication dossier basic design', 'engineering package authority approval package'.

name: input, output list
definition: An authoritative collection of values with a relationship to a specific equipment.  List to show input and output of an equipment (e.g. instrument, telecom equipment) connected to other equipment (e.g. distributed control system, programmable logic controller).The columns of this collection is specified and controlled.

name: inspection and test plan
definition: A document capturing what particular activities and requirements will be executed and delivered relating to inspection and testing for construction & vendor work.

name: installation manual
definition: A document that describes methods of installing a piece of equipment.  Installation refers to the mounting, setting, erection, etc.

name: heat tracing diagram
definition: A diagram detailing electrical tracing. Includes anchoring and expansion joint details where applicable. Drawings to indicate thicknesses, specification and limit of application.

name: interface diagram
definition: A diagrams documenting Interfaces and demarcation of responsibilities between different organizations (e.g. battery limits, terminations).

name: interface plan
definition: A document capturing what particular activities and requirements will be executed and delivered to manage interface between internal and external parties (esp. between contract scopes).

name: interface procedure
definition: A procedures around Interface management activities between internal and external parties.

name: interface register
definition: A register documenting agreements and responsibilities between internal and external parties (esp. between contract scopes).

name: invitation to tender
definition: A standardised document by which the Company invites Tenderers to submit a tender for a Contract. It encloses the conditions for the submission of a tender and gives the terms of reference or the technical qualifications required.

name: isolation philosophy
definition: A document outlining the premise and intent for isolation philosophy for safe plant operation and maintenance.

name: isometric diagram
definition: Construction detail diagram for 'piping and ducting', providing an accurate 'bill of materials' (BOM) / 'material take off' (MTO) and represented in a 3 dimensional isometric view.

name: key plan
definition: A plan view diagram of a plant/group of plants showing the interfaces of layout diagrams of components.  Typically only shows major equipment and infrastructure to provide context and orientation.

name: lessons learned report
definition: A report which documents lessons gained from the execution of the project.

name: lifting study
definition: A study determine needs for cranes and handling equipment access for project phase also access and cost related considerations to be made.  Including project related materials handling and bulk handling.

name: lifting, hoisting, and rigging plan
definition: A document capturing what particular activities and requirements will be executed and delivered for lifting, hoisting, and rigging.  Should cover scope regardless of timing in asset lifecycle.  Specific risks relating to simultaneous operations should be addressed.

name: load list
definition: An authoritative collection of electrical loads which the electrical system must accommodate listed against each piece of equipment.  The columns of this collection are specified and controlled.

name: loadout and loadin analysis
definition: A report documenting  assumptions and method determining computer analysis to verify the module design for loadout/in condition.

name: loop diagram
definition: A diagram showing details all elements of a control loop, from sensing element through to controlling element, and cabling and wiring details for the associated instruments. Includes junction box, marshalling cabinet and control panel terminations and power supply details.

name: maintenance manual
definition: A document that describes methods of maintaining a specific piece of equipment.  Typically originates from the equipment or package supplier.

name: manpower histogram
definition: A diagram detailing current and predicted manpower through project broken down by trade/profession.

name: safety datasheet
definition: A datasheet which summarizes of physical and chemical properties of the substance - description of its harmful nature including potential impact on the health and safety of personnel and of the environment - precautions necessary to ensure its safe use and eventual disposal.

name: material selection diagram
definition: A schematic diagram (ie. typically a layer on a PFS/PFD or PEFS/P&ID) showing materials selected for each component of the design. May include piping class breaks (eg. CS/SS316) and vessel internals (e.g. CS epoxy lined). Includes corrosion loop diagrams that show boundary definitions.

name: material selection study
definition: A study describes materials and reasons for selecting those materials (e.g. environmental conditions). Considered a precursor to the 'MS report' and 'MS diagram', where used.

name: material traceability report
definition: Location plans/records with an identification system cross referring to the individual material certificates.

name: mechanical handling equipment study
definition: A study identify the most appropriate mechanical handling equipment (cranes, hoists, forklift trucks, etc.) for operations and maintenance phase for the facilities.

name: metering philosophy
definition: A document outlining the premise and intent for the metering and allocation philosophy for fiscal measurement for the purpose of sales or purchase relating to utilities and/or products/feedstocks.

name: metocean analysis study
definition: A study providing an analysis of metocean data.

name: metocean reference document study
definition: A study providing the metocean design and operating conditions for the proposed offshore facilities. This document should give a complete overview of all existing metocean data (wind, waves, currents, water level and weather data) and mention all existing metocean study reports.

name: metocean survey
definition: A report describing how, when and where metocean data has been collected.  Includes bathymetric data.

name: minutes of meeting
definition: A summary of a meeting highlighting attendees, status, committed action items and issues. Minutes of meetings between client and contractor as requested in contract procedures.

name: noise datasheet
definition: A datasheet which provides information about the noise limits for the equipment to be supplied.

name: non conformance report
definition: A report documenting the condition of any product or component in which one or more characteristics do not conform to requirements. Includes failures, deficiencies, defects and malfunctions. Is often identified during an audit.

name: non destructive test procedure
definition: A procedure detailing all non-destructive tests/examinations. Excludes pressure tests.

name: operating manual
definition: A document that describes methods of operating a piece of equipment or process unit, including but not limited to Instructions, procedures, drawings, tables, etc. for the operation -stop, start, and emergency shutdown. Including operational limits, function testing, possible interruptions, corrective actions, hazards and corrective measures to be taken.

name: opportunity framing report
definition: Workshop, MOM, whitepapers, studies, brainstorm session etc.

name: organizational chart
definition: A diagram represents an organisation of people, indicating roles and reporting lines in a tree-like structure. May include the names of individuals.

name: general agreement
definition: A document which records scope and obligations as mutually agreed between two or more parties.

name: general analysis
definition: A report documenting  assumptions and method determining objective analysis of a set of data. Not to be used if a more specific document type can be used.  Can be used for singular/specialty deliverables which do not have a unique document type.

name: general assessment
definition: An assessment which details a health check, GAP analysis, etc. both informal and to meet 'project management framework' requirements. Not to be used if a more specific document type can be used. Can be used for singular/specialty deliverables which do not have a unique document type.

name: block diagram
definition: A schematic diagram which shows the relation between the main functions or the main component in the plant or group of plants.

name: general calculation
definition: A document showing inputs, formulas, rationale, and conclusions/mathematical results as required to enhance design or bound activities.

name: general certificate
definition: A document certifying compliance with specified requirements. [e.g., certificates needed for re-certifying, occupancy certificate, product certificates].Not to be used if a more specific document type can be used.  Can be used for singular/specialty deliverables which do not have a unique document type.

name: general estimate
definition: A judgement based calculation showing a summation of cost/schedule taking into consider probabilities to develop a projected performance and should document rationale, approach, inputs, etc.

name: functional design specification
definition: A specification that describes the deliverable in terms of form, fit, function, and performance characteristics to satisfy the intended use where interpretation is required.Includes most discipline specifications describing the functionality (e.g., relief and blowdown specification, surface coating, inspection specifications, operating envelopes, etc.).

name: inspection report
definition: A report documenting status and observations relating to an asset/object. Can include paint, insulation, noise, thickness measurement, destructive weld testing, NDE, preservation, cathodic protection tests, etc. Excludes pressure tests.

name: general list
definition: A collection of values with a relationship to a specific topic or object that could be either technical or business related.

name: logic diagram
definition: A graphical representation of a system using formal logic. It displays the existence of functional elements and the paths by which they interact with each other. Includes SAMA drawings.

name: general manual
definition: A document that describes methods of working to be used to accomplish an activity. Warning: this should not be a compilation of other deliverables. Not to be used if a more specific document type can be used.  Can be used for singular/specialty deliverables which do not have a unique document type.

name: multimedia
definition: Multimedia being 'picture', 'sound' or 'video'.  Includes laser scans, x-rays, sonograms, installation videos, photogrammetry, illustrations, 'fly-throughs', etc.

name: general philosophy
definition: A document outlining the premise and intent for decisions that are to be followed regarding a specific subject. Typically provided as instruction from 'owner operator'.

name: general plan
definition: A document capturing what particular activities and requirements will be executed and delivered.  Typically the plan is built upon a strategy.

name: general procedure
definition: A document which describes a set of logically sequenced instructions to execute an activity. Not to be used if a more specific document type can be used.  Can be used for singular/speciality deliverables which do not have a unique document type.

name: general proposal
definition: A document which captures a recommended course of action with justifications from technical and/or commercial aspects.

name: general register
