secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: dew point transmitter
definition: A facility for measuring dew point and transmitting a signal representing the measured temperature.

name: diaphragm seal
definition: A seal between two substance created of a impenetrable membrane.

name: differential pressure flow transmitter
definition: A flow transmitter providing an output signal that is proportional to the flow inputs from a differential pressure flow meter.

name: displacer level transmitter
definition: A level transmitter which uses a displacer as sensing element.

name: distillation analyser
definition: An analyser intended to determine the relation between the boiling temperatures and the fraction distilled. It includes the initial boiling point and the final boiling point.

name: document scanner
definition: A device used to translate print media into computer language so that a document can be viewed and read later on.

name: drilling machine
definition: An artefact which is intended to operate and supply power to an artefact (instrument) with an edged or pointed end for making holes in hard substances by revolving or by a succession of blows.

name: eductor
definition: A form of suction pump; a device using a high pressure jet of water to create partial vacuum at an intake opening to draw liquid from a sump.

name: electrical circuit
definition: Which is an arrangement of devices or media through which electrical current can flow.

name: electromagnetic flow element
definition: An element  located in a flowstream measuring the flow using electro-magnetic forces.

name: exhaust
definition: A piping assembly intended to transport exhaust gas or steam.

name: expansion joint
definition: Flexible joint between two pipes to receive expansion from the pipes.

name: eye bath
definition: A device used for cleaning your eyes.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: fall arrestor block
definition: A block fitted with a steel rope or web line, with an emergency locking retractor and an automatic retrieval mechanism  that is designed to offer protection to workers at heights.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: fax machine
definition: Machine capable of transmitting written input via telephone lines.

name: fence
definition: Is an artefact intended to act as a barrier and boundary or means of protection or confinement.

name: fire blanket
definition: A type of cover made of a material which does not burn very easily, which you throw over a fire to put it out or stop it from spreading.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: fire damper
definition: A closure intended for sealing off a duct in case of fire.

name: fire door
definition: A door capable of withstanding fire for a certain period of time and preventing fire from diverging.

name: fire fighting vehicle
definition: A fire fighting vehicle.

name: fire hydrant
definition: A device where hoses can be connected for drawing water for fire fighting.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: fired heater
definition: Is a fired heat transfer equipment intended to burn fuel and to transfer the heat of combustion to a liquid without vaporising the liquid.
secondaryLabel: Parent: fired heat transfer equipment class

name: firewater monitor
definition: The firewater discharge controller.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: first aid kit
definition: A collection of functional equipment intended to be used for first aid service in case of emergency.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: flame arrestor
definition: An arrestor which is a trap over an opening, e.g. of a ventilation system or a pipe, to prevent flames from entering the system.

name: flame switch
definition: A specially designed switch with connections for inputs from multiple flame detectors. The switch has a built in logic to determine the presence of a flame based on these inputs.

name: flare
definition: A system that burns waste in an elevated flame in the open air.
secondaryLabel: Parent: fired heat transfer equipment class

name: flash drum
definition: A tank or vessel in which a process stream is charged or pumped and where lighter products flash off or vaporize and are drawn off at the top. The remainder heavier fractions are drawn off at the bottom of the vessel.

name: flow orifice plate
definition: An orifice plate which restrict the flow and thus develops the differential pressure that is proportional to the square of the flow rate.

name: fog detector
definition: A device capable of detecting droplets of water vapour suspended in the air near the ground.

name: foundation
definition: Materials used to transfer loads to the ground and maintain structural stability.

name: freezing point analyser
definition: An analyser intended to determine the freezing point of a liquid.

name: funnel
definition: A hollow cone with a tube extending from the smaller end and that is designed to catch and direct a downward flow.

name: furniture
definition: Is an artefact which is necessary, useful or desirable, especially for living or working but is not a tool for production.

name: fusible plug
definition: A plug capable of being melted and fused.

name: galvanic isolator
definition: Galvanic isolation is the principle of isolating functional sections of electric systems so that charge-carrying particles cannot move from one section to another.

name: gas composition analyser
definition: An analyser which analyses the composition of gaseous mixture with two or more components.

name: gas cyclone separator
definition: A static device generating centrifugal force from an incoming flow which separates solid or liquids from a gas of a different density.

name: general instrument
definition: A process instrument that records values represented by the input signal(s).

name: grease injection unit
definition: A system that injects grease for lubrication or sealing.

name: grille
definition: Is a framework of metal bars or wire which is placed in front of something. Often a terminal unit for delivering supply air to a room or for collecting extract air from a room.

name: grinding machine
definition: An artefact which is intended to wear down, polish, or sharpen by the abrasive action of a high-speed grinding wheel or disc.

name: guide post
definition: An artefact which is an upstanding tapered shaft or rod fixed to a permanent guide base and intended to be used to guide equipment to the seabed.

name: hard disk
definition: An electromagnetic storage device, continuously available within a computer system.

name: heat and smoke detector
definition: A detector capable of detecting both heat and smoke.

name: horn
definition: An alarm device that makes a loud warning sound.

name: hose
definition: A tubular which is flexible and capable of conveying liquids under pressure.

name: hose reel
definition: A reel capable of holding a hose.

name: humidifier
definition: Device used to increase the humidity in air by adding water under pressure as a spray into the air.

name: humidity analyser
definition: A meter intended to measure and indicate and/or produce a signal which represents the measured humidity.

name: hydraulic connector
definition: An artefact for releasably connecting hydraulic fluid lines, having means for closing the fluid path when the connector is released.

name: hydraulic power supply
definition: An arrangement to supply hydraulic power according to specified levels and tolerances.

name: ignitor
definition: A device which is intended to initiate a spark that ignites a combustible mixture.

name: industrial building
definition: A building or area within a building that is used for activities associated with manufacturing, engineering works and maintenance and is not an office building.

name: infrastructure
definition: A basic physical and organizational structure or facilities (e.g. buildings and roads) needed for the operation of a site.

name: instrument equipment
definition: A physical object that detects an aspect of something; records, modifies and/or displays such an aspect or performs a combination of these activities.

name: instrument loop
definition: Which is a structure of related instrumentation and control components intended to perform a measurement, control, actuation, monitoring and/or safeguarding activity.

name: intercom
definition: Is a communication system.

name: IT and telecom equipment
definition: Technology and Infrastructure to manage electronic information handling.

name: agitator
definition: A propeller like device with agitational or rotational movement located in a tank to prevent the content of the tank to build component segments.

name: air balancing unit
definition: An air balancing unit on a nodding donkey.

name: air handling unit
definition: An artefact intended for central conditioning and pressure increase of ventilation air.

name: analyser element
definition: Is an artefact intended to retrieve a material at a particular location and inserted into something so as to test its conditions.

name: analysing instrument
definition: A detecting instrument that is intended to analyse a substance for its composition and/or properties.

name: attenuator
definition: An attenuator is a telecommunication device that reduces the amplitude of a signal without appreciably distorting its waveform. Attenuators are usually passive devices. The degree of attenuation may be fixed, continuously adjustable, or incrementally adjustable.

name: axial displacement transmitter
definition: A transmitter measuring an axial displacement and generating a standardized output signal representing the axial measured displacement.

name: balancing damper
definition: Is a gas flow damper intended to adjust an air flow rate through a duct.

name: jetty
definition: A loading and/or unloading system which is located in water deep enough for a ship to moor.

name: lathe
definition: In woodturning, metalworking, metalspinning, and glassworking, a lathe is a machine tool which spins a block of material so that when abrasive, cutting, or deformation tools are applied to the block, it can be shaped to produce an object which has rotational symmetry about an axis of rotation.

name: level instrument
definition: A physical object that detects levels; records, modifies and/or displays or performs a combination of these activities.

name: life buoy
definition: An artefact for the rescue of personnel from an installation in the case of an emergency situation.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: life buoy light
definition: A facility to give light when the life buoy is in the water.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: life raft
definition: An artefact which is a raft for emergency situations.

name: lifting beam
definition: Is a solid or fabricated metal or wooden beam, suspended from a hoist/crane or from a forklift, designed to provide multiple lifting points.

name: lifting cap
definition: A lifting device also serving as a cover or protection.

name: line blind
definition: A functional unit used to blind off a process stream.

name: liquid composition analyser
definition: An analyser for liquid.

name: liquid detector
definition: A detector which is capable of detecting selected types of liquids.

name: load cell
definition: A transducer which produces a signal with a defined relationship to the force applied to it.

name: logic cap
definition: A retrievable and configurable device to route and re-route flow true the cap.

name: louvre
definition: An artefact which contains fins or vanes intended to control a flow of air. Typically also to separate water droplets from an air stream.

name: magnetic level transmitter
definition: A level transmitter which uses a floater and magnetic contacts to measure and transmit level.

name: manual call point
definition: A manual call point is a device which enables personnel to raise an alarm in the event of a fire incident by pressing a frangible element to activate the alarm system.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: manual control switch
definition: A control switch that is operated by a person.

name: marine
definition: A physical object that is related to the sea or sea transport.

name: mast
definition: Is a support (item).

name: mechanical connector
definition: An artefact which is a pipeline fitting used to create a rigid pressure containing joint in a pipeline or flowline.

name: meter prover
definition: An artefact for the calibration of flow meters.

name: microphone
definition: A microphone, sometimes called a mic (pronounced mike), is a device that converts sound into an electrical signal.

name: miscellaneous equipment
definition: An equipment class that contains classes that not covered by any other parent class.

name: modem
definition: Short for modulator/demodulator. A communications device that converts one form of a signal to another that is suitable for transmission over communication circuits, typically from digital to analogue and then from analogue to digital.

name: mounting bracket
definition: Is a bracket intended to attach an item to another item.

name: multi property analyser
definition: An analyser giving as output a signal that represents more than one physical properties of the analysed substance.

name: multiplexer
definition: Is an artefact intended for a number of input channels to share one output channel.

name: net oil computer
definition: A very accurate flow meter used to record oil exports.

name: office building
definition: Is a building intended to provide a working space for people and their resources.

name: optical beacon
definition: A post or buoy placed over a shoal or bank to warn vessels, also a signal mark on land.

name: overhead projector
definition: Equipment which projects an image on a screen by passing light through a transparent slide or other transparency.

name: overhead runway beam
definition: Is a fixed assembly of rails or beams, girders, brackets and framework on which a movable or fixed hoisting mechanism travels.

name: package
definition: An artefact which is a collection of artefacts to be managed as one for some purpose.

name: padeye
definition: A facility used to fasten lifting or movement equipment to the structure. A padeye have hole for a shackle.

name: pager
definition: One-way communications device in which the intended receiver is alerted to receive a message or return a phone call.

name: paging system
definition: A system intended to contact people through a pager. It is pre-date mobile phone technology.

name: personnel basket
definition: A container that can be attached to a hook for lifting one or more people.

name: pH element
definition: An element designed to measure pH (potential of Hydrogen).

name: pig launcher
definition: A pressure vessel intended for sending a pig into a pipeline.

name: pig loop
definition: A flowloop that allows a pipeline pig to move from one pipe to another.

name: pig receiver
definition: A pressure vessel intended for receiving a pig from a pipeline.

name: pig transmitter
definition: A transmitter intended to detect a pig passage and transmit a signal representing the measured value.

name: pig trap
definition: A facility on a pipeline for inserting and retrieving a scraper or pig.

name: pipe bending machine
definition: An artefact which is intended for bending pipes.

name: piping and pipeline equipment
definition: A physical object used in or in connection with a piping system.

name: piping spool
definition: Is a piping assembly of piping components to be pre-fabricated as one item.

name: positioning system
definition: A handheld or fixed device designed to identify and record the location of an object on the earth's surface. GPS, GALILEO, SYLEDIS, HYPERFIX, LORAN-C, DECCA etc. are all brands and working on different networks.

name: positive displacement flow element
definition: Elements like impellers rotating by the pressure of the fluid  in a closed conduit to measure the flow of a liquid.

name: power stabiliser
definition: A device that removes voltage spikes from an AC or DC electrical supply.

name: process data acquisition and control
definition: Is a facilty for measure & control, including the main plant computerized operational system, where all process, utility and off site activities are monitored. The system may be located in the main control room. (e.g. PLC Programmable logic controller, DCS distributed control system, ENMC Electrical Network Monitoring and Control system).

name: public address and alarm system
definition: Is an alarm system.

name: rack
definition: A mechanical structure intended to receive a number of pieces of basically standardized modular equipment.

name: radar level element
definition: An element intended to determine a level based on high frequency electromagnetic waves.

name: radiator
definition: Is a heat exchanger which cools a fluid and heats the surrounding environment.

name: radio caravan
definition: A mobile radio communications centre.

name: radio transceiver
definition: A transceiver which has the methods of signalling through space, without connecting wires.

name: radioactive source
definition: Intended to generate radioactive radiation.

name: reader
definition: Is a piece of hardware intended to read and decode information encoded on a carrier.

name: redox analyser
definition: An analyser intended to determine the oxidation and reduction capability of material.

name: relative pressure transmitter
definition: A pressure transmitter where pressure is applied to one side of the sensor while the other side is open to atmosphere. The transmitter generate standardized output signal representing the measured value.

name: remote terminal unit
definition: A RTU, or Remote Terminal Unit is a device which interfaces objects in the physical world to a DCS or SCADA system by transmitting telemetry data to the system and/or altering the state of connected objects based on control messages received from the system.

name: residential building
definition: Assigned for living and accommodation.

name: road
definition: Is a civil item intended for vehicle traffic.

name: router
definition: A router is a computer networking device that forwards data packets toward their destinations through a process known as routing. Routing occurs at layer 3 (Network layer) of the OSI seven-layer model.

name: safety barrier
definition: Safety barriers are devices that limit the current, voltage, and total energy delivered to a sensor in a hazardous area or flammable environment in order to prevent an explosion.

name: sample loop component
definition: A sample loop adds a predetermined volume to the process.

name: satellite communications terminal
definition: A system that provides voice and telefax communication via satellites.

name: screw conveyor
definition: Is a conveyer intended to move dry, solid material from one location to another by means of a helix or screw rotating in a cylindrical conduit.

name: selector switch
definition: A manual control switch which has more then two possible positioning states.

name: shale shaker
definition: A vibrating screen for sifting out rock cuttings from drilling mud.

name: other mechanical equipment
definition: An equipment class that contains classes that normally are the responsibility of a department for mechanical engineering that are not covered by the mechanical equipment class.

name: sheave
definition: A wheel which is grooved for use with vee-belts, ropes, round belts, wire or pipe.

name: shut off damper
definition: A damper intended for closing off parts of a ventilation system.

name: side pocket mandrel
definition: A completion component that is used to house gas-lift valves and similar devices that require communication with the annulus.

name: signal
definition: A detectable transmitted energy (e.g. voltage, current, pneumatic or magnetic field strength) by which information can be transmitted.

name: signal splitter
definition: A device with one input and at least two outputs used for dividing a detectable transmitted energy (as a voltage, current, or  magnetic field strength) by which information can be transmitted.

name: single buoy mooring
definition: A Single buoy mooring (SBM) or Single point mooring (SPM) is a loading buoy anchored offshore that serves as a mooring point and interconnect for tankers loading or offloading gas or fluid products. SBMs are the link between the geostatic subsea manifold connections and the weathervaning tanker. They are capable of handling any size ship, even very large crude carriers (VLCC) where no alternative facility is available.

name: sink
definition: A large basin with taps that supplies water.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: skimmer
definition: Device which separates oil from water by mechanically wipe the oil of the water surface.

name: snatch block
definition: A block through which a rope can be reeved without access to an end.

name: software function
definition: Is a software intended to describe a process step in a computer language. Typically a software implementation of a control function.

name: solid composition analyser
definition: An analyser intended to determine a mixture of solid particles in liquids or solid or liquid droplets in air.

name: sand detector
definition: A detector intended to detect sand in a fluid.

name: sound attenuator
definition: A device decreasing noise in a HVAC system.

name: sound pressure level analyser
definition: A meter intended to measure a sound pressure level.

name: spark arrestor
definition: A device which removes incandescent particles from a gas stream. Spark arrestors are fitted to vehicles and stationary engines which are operated in potentially flammable atmospheres.

name: special tool
definition: A device that is made as a tool to be used for a special purpose.

name: specific gravity analyser
definition: An analyser intended to determine specific gravity's of materials. Typically of liquids.

name: spreader bar
definition: A beam that is used to spread ropes or slings when lifting.

name: spring support
definition: Is a support (item) intended to carry the load of piping components.

name: stack
definition: Is a support structure intended to support a flare or vent pipe.

name: stroke length adjuster
definition: A mechanical device capable of reducing the stroke length of a pump.

name: sump
definition: Is an artefact intended to collect a heavy phase by making use of gravity.

name: swivel joint
definition: An artefact joining two parts so that one or both can pivot freely (as on a bolt or pin).

name: tape drive
definition: A device that transfer data between a computer and a magnetic tape.

name: temperature instrument
definition: A physical object that detects temperatures; records, modifies and/or displays or performs a combination of these activities.

name: thermal flow element
definition: An element which uses the principle of thermal conductivity to measure volume flow rate.

name: thermal flow transmitter
definition: A velocity flow meter which uses the principle of thermal conductivity to measure volume flow rate.

name: tool
definition: A device that is a mechanical implement for working upon something, as by cutting, striking, rubbing or other processes, in any manual art or industry; usually, one held in and operated by the hand (or fixed in position, as in a lath), but also including certain simple machines, as the lathe; sometimes extended to simple instruments of other kinds.

name: trailer
definition: Is a vehicle which is nonautomotive and is designed to be hauled by road.

name: turbine flow transmitter
definition: A transmitter specially designed to convert the signal in a turbine meter into a standardized output signal.

name: ultrasonic flow transmitter
definition: A flow transmitter providing electrical outputs that are proportional to the flow inputs from an ultrasonic flow meter.

name: ultrasonic level element
definition: An element intended to determine a level based on  ultrasonic sound waves.

name: umbilical
definition: An assembly of hydraulic hoses which can also include electrical cables or optic fibres, used to control a sub sea structure or remote operated vehicle from a platform or a vessel.

name: UV sterilizer
definition: Is a sterilizer intended to make use of ultraviolet light.

name: vapour pressure analyser
definition: An analyser intended to determine a vapor pressure.

name: vibration switch
definition: A switch intended to give a on/off signal when vibration level have reached a pre-set value.

name: video converter
definition: A signal converter intended to convert one video signal type to another video signal type.

name: video monitor
definition: A facility with the capability of receiving  video signals and displaying pictures.

name: voltage transmitter
definition: A transmitter which output is relative to a measured voltage.

name: vortex flow transmitter
definition: A transmitter specially designed to convert the signal in a vortex flow meter into a standardized output signal.

name: waste compactor
definition: A compactor is a machine or mechanism used to reduce the size of waste material.

name: water cooler
definition: A water cooler is a device that cools and dispenses water.

name: water desalination system
definition: Is a fresh water system.

name: water maker
definition: A device for producing drinking water, but not necessarily by reverse osmosis.

name: well
definition: A well is a collection of (zero or more) holes drilled into the Earth for the purpose of either (1) finding or producing underground resources; or (2) providing services related to the production of underground resources.

name: wellhead
definition: The wellhead is assembled from, or incorporates facilities for, the upper casing and tubing hangers. This effectively provides the upper termination of the wellbore and provides a mounting position for the surface flow-control equipment or Christmas tree.

name: winch
definition: A powerful machine with one or more drums on which to coil a rope, cable, or chain for hauling or hoisting.

name: anemometer
definition: A detecting instrument for recording wind speed, and possibly wind direction.

name: wire hoist
definition: A hoist utilizing a wire-rope for suspending load. Wire hoists are normally electrically powered, but also (hand) lever types exists.

name: wire line unit
definition: Is a well services facility intended to handle wire lines.

name: wire sling
definition: A sling for enclosing material to be hoisted by a tackle or crane made by wire.

name: wireless access point
definition: A wireless access point (WAP) is a device that allows wired communication devices to connect to a wireless network using Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or related standards. The WAP usually connects to a router, and can relay data between the wireless devices (such as computers or printers) and wired devices on the network.

name: damper
definition: A device that damps, typically a valve or plate (as in the flue of a furnace) for regulating the draft, or a device to stop vibration, typically a shock absorber or snubber.

name: indicating instrument
definition: A device which gives a visual indication of a measured value.

name: down hole safety valve
definition: A valve that is intended for subsurface control/check operation.

name: relief valve
definition: A self operating valve that is set to open at a certain pressure level to prevent the pressure in a container or system from reaching unsafe levels.

name: basin
definition: A container intended to store liquid or solid material partly or totally below grade and that is typically open.

name: basket
definition: A container that has a characteristic shape and that is made of material with an open structure.

name: cap
definition: A physical object that is a hood or covering for the top or end of something.

name: chamber
definition: A physical object that is an enclosed space.

name: door
definition: A physical object that is an opening in a barrier and a removable physical object that can block the opening.

name: enclosure
definition: A physical object that separates enclosed physical objects from those outside.

name: flange
definition: A physical object that is a projecting flat rim, plate, collar or rib.

name: frame
definition: A physical object that is an open structure of beams or bars.

name: gasket
definition: A seal that is one or more closed loops of deformable material used between mating surfaces which have only very limited movement relative to each other.

name: housing
definition: An enclosure that also provides support.

name: manifold
definition: A physical object that contains a chamber with several openings.

name: seal
definition: A physical object intended to reduce or prevent the passage of fluid through an opening.

name: electrical equipment class
definition: An equipment class that contains classes of artefacts which is electrical equipment.

name: class
definition: An artefact class that contains classes of artefacts or physical resources required for a purpose.

name: fired heat transfer equipment class
definition: An equipment class that contains heat transfer equipment items with a purpose related to combustion.

name: health, safety and environment equipment class
definition: An equipment class that contains classes of artefacts intended to be used to provide health and safety and to prevent environmental hazards.

name: mechanical equipment class
definition: An equipment class that contains classes that normally are the responsibility of a department for mechanical engineering.

name: accumulator
definition: A physical object for storing energy, and which after discharge may be recharged.

name: amplifier
definition: A physical object for increasing the power of a signal.

name: anode
definition: A physical object that is capable of emitting positive charge carriers to and/or receiving negative charge carriers from the medium of lower conductivity.

name: battery back-up power supply unit
definition: A direct current power supply unit intended to supply stabilised DC electric power according to specified levels and tolerances.

name: battery charger
definition: A direct current power supply unit for charging batteries.

name: busbar
definition: An electrical conductor that is of low-impedance, to which several electric circuits can be connected at separate points.

name: cable reel
definition: A physical object that is a reel on to which cable is wound during manufacture, for storage, transportation and installation.

name: capacitor bank
definition: A physical object that is a number of capacitor units connected so as to act together.

name: circuit-breaker
definition: A mechanical switching device that at regular intervals interrupts an electric current.

name: clock
definition: A timepiece for the measurement of time.

name: conductivity transmitter
definition: A transmitter that is intended to measure and transmit conductivity.

name: contactor
definition: A mechanical switching device having only one position of rest, operated otherwise than by hand, capable of making, carrying and breaking currents under normal circuit conditions including operating overload conditions.

name: control panel
definition: An instrument panel containing a set of indicating devices and control units required for operation of a system or part of it.

name: current transmitter
definition: A transmitter that transmits an analogue electrical current.

name: distribution board
definition: A switchgear and controlgear that is an insulated  panel carrying terminals, fuses, etc, for controlling a number of subsidiary electrical circuits.

name: earth busbar
definition: An electrical conductor that is a busbar used for earthing.

name: earth electrode
definition: An electrode, which is the conductive part, that can be embedded in a specific conductive medium, e.g. concrete or coke, in electric contact with the Earth.

name: earth leakage detector
definition: A detector intended to detect a leakage current to earth.

name: earth plate
definition: An electrode that is an earth electrode consisting of a metal plate buried in the ground.

name: earthing boss
definition: An electrical conductor that is used to connect the earthing system to structure.

name: electric actuator
definition: An actuator that produces a specified movement when excited by an electric signal.

name: electric battery
definition: An electric accumulator that comprises one or more cells fitted with devices necessary for use, for example case, terminals, marking and protective devices.

name: electric generator
definition: An energy transducer that transforms non-electric energy into electric energy.

name: electric heater
definition: A heater in which electric energy is converted into heat for useful purposes.

name: electric motor
definition: An electric machine for transforming electric energy into mechanical energy.

name: electrical motor starter
definition: A starter in which the force for closing the main contacts is provided exclusively by electrical energy.

name: electrical socket
definition: An electrical connector in which the terminals of an electricity supply are inside holes made to receive the pins of a plug.

name: electronic frequency converter
definition: An electronic ac converter for changing the frequency.

name: electronic power inverter
definition: An electronic converter that changes direct electric current to single-phase or polyphase alternating currents.

name: floodlight
definition: A projector providing a beam of intense illumination.

name: fuse
definition: A physical object that by the fusing of one or more of its specially designed and proportioned components, opens the circuit in which it is inserted by breaking the current when this exceeds a given value for a sufficient time.

name: heating cable
definition: An electric cable, that is also an electric heater, with or without a shield or a metallic sheath, intended to give off heat for heating purposes.

name: high-pass filter
definition: An electrical filter having a single pass-band extending from a specified cut-off frequency upwards.

name: interlocking device
definition: A physical object that makes the operation of a piece of equipment dependent upon the condition, position or operation of one or more other pieces of equipment.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: isolator
definition: A physical object that isolates.

name: junction box
definition: A physical object that is a closed, rigid box or casing used to enclose and protect the junctions of electric wires or cables.

name: lamp
definition: A physical object intended to produce an optical radiation, usually visible.

name: low-pass filter
definition: An electrical filter having a single pass-band extending from zero frequency to a specified cut-off frequency.

name: luminaire
definition: A physical object that is an electric light and its fittings.

name: power cable
definition: An electric cable intended for transmission of electric power.

name: power supply unit
definition: A physical object intended to supply electric power according to specified levels and tolerances.

name: transformer
definition: A transformer that, by electromagnetic induction, transforms a system of alternating voltage and current into another system of voltage and current usually of different values and at the same frequency for the purpose of transmitting electrical power.

name: rectifier
definition: An electric converter for converting an alternating current into a direct current.

name: relay
definition: A physical object that can be any electrical device, usually incorporating an electromagnet, whereby a current or signal in one circuit can open or close another circuit.

name: signal cable
definition: An electric cable intended for  transmission of electric signals.

name: solenoid
definition: An electromagnetic coil, which is a cylindrical coil, the length of which is much greater than its transverse dimensions and which is used to produce a magnetic field.

name: switchboard
definition: A switchgear and controlgear bearing a set of switches for connecting and disconnecting the various circuits of an electrical system, as of a telegraph, telephone, etc.

name: switchgear and controlgear
definition: A physical object that is a general term covering switching devices and their combination with associated control, measuring, protective and regulating equipment, also assemblies of such devices and equipment with associated interconnections, accessories, enclosures and supporting structures.

name: telephone
definition: A physical object that converts sound signals into corresponding variations of electric current (or potential), which is transmitted by wire or radio to a distant point where it is reconverted into sound.

name: temperature detector
definition: A detector intended to detect temperature.

name: thermostatic switch
definition: A pilot switch whose function is controlled by variations of temperature and whose contacts make or break automatically a load circuit when the temperature of the ambient space in which its sensing element placed or the temperature of the surface on which it is fixed reaches a predetermined value.

name: thyristor
definition: A semiconductor device that is a three-terminal semiconductor rectifier made up of four layers, p-n-p-n, so that when the fourth is positive with respect to the first, a voltage pulse applied to the third layer initiates a flow of current through the device which continues as long as it is greater than some minimum value.

name: trip amplifier
definition: A pilot switch intended to create a switch action at a pre-set value.

name: ups unit
definition: An ac power supply unit that maintains a continuous supply of electric power to the equipment it protects.

name: variable speed drive unit
definition: A physical object that consists of an electric motor and controller that is used to adjust the motor's operating speed.

name: vibration transmitter
definition: A transmitter of which the output is proportional to a measured vibration.

name: weight transmitter
definition: A transmitter for weighing large quantities of material, and of which the output is proportional to the measured weight.

name: welding set
definition: A physical object for arc welding, either ac or dc, comprising a supply unit and a regulator.

name: air conditioner
definition: A physical object that is intended to bring air to a specified quality.

name: air cooled heat exchanger
definition: A cooler that is intended to use air as the cooling medium.

name: boiler
definition: An indirect contact heat exchanger that is intended to heat a liquid.

name: condenser
definition: A cooler that is intended to change a vapour to liquid.

name: cooler
definition: A heat exchanger that is intended to cool a physical object.

name: cooling tower
definition: A cooler and an air cooled heat exchanger that is a tall structure through which air circulates by convection.

name: drier
definition: A drier is a physical object that is intended to remove absorbed or adsorbed liquid or water vapour below saturation state.

name: flare tip
definition: A burner that burns gas emitted from a process into the atmosphere.
secondaryLabel: Parent: fired heat transfer equipment class

name: heat exchanger
definition: A physical object that is intended to transfer heat from one object to another.

name: incinerator
definition: A furnace that is intended for the combustion of waste material.
secondaryLabel: Parent: fired heat transfer equipment class

name: absolute pressure transmitter
definition: A pressure transmitter where pressure is applied to one side of the sensor while the other side has a vacuum chamber.

name: antenna
definition: An electromagnetic transducer that is a physical object made of conducting material which is capable of radiating or receiving electromagnetic waves.

name: axial displacement element
definition: A detecting element that is intended to detect axial displacement.

name: bell
definition: A physical object that is a hollow body with a flared mouth made of cast metal. Formed to emit a clear musical sound by the sonorous vibration of its entire circumference when struck by a clapper, hammer or other appliance.

name: capacitance probe
definition: A detecting element that is intended to detect changes in the dielectric constant.

name: cloud point analyser
definition: An analysing instrument that is intended to determine the cloud point of a fluid.

name: computer
definition: A physical object that can store data and program(s) that operates on the data. A general purpose computer can be programmed to solve any reasonable problem expressed in logical and arithmetical terms.

name: conductivity cell
definition: A detecting element or probe that is used with a conductivity meter to measure the conductivity of a liquid.

name: conductivity level transmitter
definition: A transmitter that is producing a standardized output signal dependent of a received input signal from a conductivity meter.

name: control box
definition: A terminal box that is used as accommodation for control function circuits.

name: coriolis mass flow meter
definition: A mass flow meter that uses the Coriolis principle to measure a mass flow rate through the meter.

name: corrosion meter
definition: A detecting instrument intended to measure, indicate and/or produce a signal which represents the rate or degree of corrosion.

name: corrosion element
definition: A detecting element that is a piece of suitable metal meant to corrode and give an indication of the corrosion rate.

name: counter
definition: A detecting instrument that counts, especially an electronic or mechanical device that automatically counts occurrences or repetitions of phenomena or events.

name: current to current converter
definition: A signal converter that is intended to convert one current signal to another current signal.

name: current to pressure converter
definition: A signal converter that is intended to convert an analogue signal (4 - 20 mA) to a proportional linear pneumatic output signal.

name: current to voltage converter
definition: A signal converter that is intended to convert a current input signal to a proportional voltage output signal.

name: density analyser
definition: An analysing instrument intended to determine the density of a substance.

name: dew point analyser
definition: An analysing instrument intended to determine the dew point of a substance.

name: differential pressure gauge
definition: A gauge that is intended for measuring and indicating pressure differences.

name: differential pressure level transmitter
definition: A level transmitter that is measuring liquid level by sensing pressure difference between two points, e.g. the hydrostatic pressure at the bottom of a tank to the atmosphere pressure.

name: differential pressure switch
definition: A pilot switch intended to switch or give an on/off signal when the measured differential pressure has reached a pre-set value.

name: differential pressure transmitter
definition: A pressure transmitter that is producing a standardized output signal dependent of a received pressure difference signal.

name: coupling
definition: Connecting with a coupling or coupler.

name: electromagnetic flow transmitter
definition: A flow transmitter that is specially designed to convert the signals from an electromagnetic flow meter into a standardized electrical output signal.

name: electronic controller
definition: A controller that uses in-built algorithms executed by electronic circuitry to perform its function.

name: flame detector
definition: A detector that is intended to sense a flame.

name: flash point analyser
definition: An analysing instrument intended to determine the flash point of a substance.

name: flow gauge
definition: A gauge intended to indicate a liquid or gas flow.

name: flow regulator
definition: A regulator that normally use the differential pressure principle across an orifice to control the valve trim and regulate flow.

name: flow switch
definition: A functional switch that is intended to give a signal when the flow have reached a pre-set value.

name: frequency to current converter
definition: A signal converter that is intended to convert a frequency or rotational speed input signal into a 0 - 20 mA or 4 - 20 mA current output signal.

name: gas detector
definition: A detector that is intended to sense the presence of a specified concentration of a gas.

name: hydraulic actuator
definition: An actuator intended to be operated by hydraulic power.

name: hydraulic controller
definition: A controller that is designed or can be programmed to operate and control hydraulic operated systems.

name: keyboard
definition: A control panel with an array of systematically arranged (piano like) keys by which a machine is operated or by which an instrument can be played on.

name: loudspeaker
definition: An electroacoustic transducer that converts an electric signal into sound.

name: magnetic level gauge
definition: A level gauge that use a float containing a magnet to transfer information about its position to a indicator rail with white and red flaps mounted on the outside of the tube.

name: mechanical positioner
definition: A mechanical controller that is intended to position a given item in accordance with a received input signal.

name: ph analyser
definition: An analysing instrument intended to measure, indicate and/or produce a signal which represents the measured alkalinity / acidity in a fluid or matter.

name: pig detector
definition: A detector that is intended to detect a pig inside the pipeline or pig receiver.

name: pitot tube
definition: A fluid sensor producing a differential pressure by means of two straigth tubes mounted in line with the direction of the fluid movement. One tube is open-ended and measures the stagnation pressure of the fluid. The other tube is closed in front but has openings along the tube to measure the static pressure of the fluid.

name: pneumatic actuator
definition: An actuator that is intended to be operated by pneumatic power.

name: pneumatic controller
definition: A mechanical controller that is using pneumatic components to execute its function.

name: position transmitter
definition: A transmitter that is producing a standardized output signal dependent of a received input signal from a position detector.

name: positive displacement flow transmitter
definition: A flow transmitter specially designed to convert the signal from a positive displacement flow meter into a standardized electrical output signal.

name: pour point analyser
definition: An analysing instrument intended to determine the pour point of a fluid, i.e. the lowest temperature at which an oil or other liquid will pour under given conditions.

name: pressure gauge
definition: A gauge intended to measure and display a representation of a measured pressure.

name: pressure regulator
definition: A regulator that is controlling/regulating the pressure in a system.

name: pressure switch
definition: A functional switch that (usually) turns an electrical circuit on or off when the pressure level reaches a pre-set value.

name: pressure to current converter
definition: A signal converter that is intended to convert a pressure input signal to DC output signal.

name: printing machine
definition: A physical object that produces characters or graphic symbols on paper or other medium.

name: proximity element
definition: A detecting element that is intended to sense proximity.

name: proximity switch
definition: A position switch that is operated without mechanical contact with the moving part.

name: push button
definition: A manual control switch that is intended to switch when you push or touch the button.

name: radar level transmitter
definition: A level transmitter that is producing a standardized electrical output signal based on the input signal from a radar type level sensor.

name: radioactive level transmitter
definition: A level transmitter that is producing a standardized electrical output signal based on the input signal from radioactive level measurements.

name: recording instrument
definition: A process instrument that records values represented by the input signal(s).

name: resistance temperature element
definition: A temperature sensing element that operate on the principle of changes in electrical resistance of pure metals (sintered semiconductor material) and are characterized by an almost linear positive change in resistance with temperature.

name: restriction orifice plate
definition: An orifice plate that is intended for use as a restrictor.

name: rotameter flow meter
definition: A variable area flow meter which consists of a tapered tube of glass with a float inside that is pushed up by flow and pulled down by gravity.

name: rupture disc
definition: A physical object that is a pressure relieving device designed to burst at a calibrated pressure to prevent pressure in systems or vessels from reaching unsafe levels.

name: sampler
definition: A physical object intended to be used to collect and contain representative specimens or selections.

name: servo tank gauge
definition: A tank gauge that is intended to intermittently lower a displacer to measure a liquid level, bottom level, interface level or density.

name: smoke detector
definition: A detector that is intended to sense smoke.

name: speed meter
definition: A detecting instrument that is intended to measure the upload and download speed of an internet connection.

name: speed transmitter
definition: A transmitter that is producing a standardized output signal dependent of a received input signal from a rotational speed sensor.

name: temperature gauge
definition: A gauge that is intended to measure and indicate a temperature.

name: temperature regulator
definition: A regulator that is intended to keep a temperature within certain boundaries.

name: temperature switch
definition: A functional switch that is intended to give an on or off signal when the temperature have reached a pre-set value.

name: temperature transmitter
definition: A transmitter that is producing a standardized output signal dependent of a received input signal from a temperature element.

name: thermal conductivity analyser
definition: An analysing instrument that is intended to determine a physical property that is named thermal conductivity.

name: thermocouple
definition: A pair of electrical conductors of dissimilar materials, joined at one end (the measuring or hot junction), which produces an electromotive force (e.m.f.) due to the Seebeck effect in a circuit formed by connecting the other ends of the dissimilar materials used (the reference or cold junction) to a device for measuring e.m.f.  Def. acc. to IEC 902 1987.

name: thermowell
definition: A physical object that is a pressure-tight receptacle adapted to receive a temperature sensing element, provided with external threads or other means for pressure-tight attachment to a vessel or pipe.

name: timer
definition: A timepiece that measures a time interval and signals its end; a time-switch.

name: transponder
definition: A transceiver that transmits a signal automatically in response to an appropriate triggering signal.

name: turbine flow meter
definition: A velocity flow meter that uses a multi bladed rotor to measure fluid flow rate in units of volumetric flow through a closed conduit.

name: ultrasonic flow meter
definition: A velocity flow meter that measures the velocity of a flow by measuring the time difference between an ultrasonic pulse sent in the flow direction and an ultrasound pulse sent opposite the flow direction.

name: ultrasonic level transmitter
definition: A level transmitter that is using ultrasonic sound to continuously monitor the level of a liquid or particulate matter in a tank or vessel.

name: v-cone flow meter
definition: A differential pressure flow meter that uses a v-cone as the restriction body in the flow stream.

name: venturi tube
definition: A pipe or tube that has a constriction with a relative long passage with a smooth coned entry and exit.

name: vibration element
definition: A detecting element that is intended to sense mechanical vibration and in which the oscillating motion is transferred into a voltage or current signal.

name: video recorder
definition: A recording instrument that is recording signals originated by a TV camera on a moving magnetic tape for subsequent reproduction or transmission.

name: viscosity analyser
definition: An analysing instrument intended to determine the viscosity of a fluid.

name: voltage to current converter
definition: A signal converter that is intended for converting an input voltage signal into an output current signal.

name: vortex flow meter
definition: A flow meter that measures the velocity of a fluid in a pipe by detecting the frequency of vortices being shed from a specially shaped obstructing element in the fluid stream.

name: wind sensor
definition: A detecting element that can be the sensing element of an anemometer or wind gauge.

name: wobbe index meter
definition: An analysing instrument intended to determine the wobble index of a gas.

name: christmas tree
definition: A physical object that is an assembly of pipes and piping parts, with valves and associated control equipment that is connected to the top of a wellhead and is intended for control of fluid from a well.

name: nozzle
definition: A physical object that has a protruding part through which a stream of fluid is directed.

name: pipe
definition: A physical object that is a long tube or hollow body intended for conduction of liquid, gaseous or finely divided solid materials, or used for structural purposes.

name: pipe bend
definition: A physical object that is used to change piping direction with a non-standard radius.

name: pipe flange spade
definition: A physical object that is a circular plate with no central opening and holes to match mating flanged ends. It is also equipped with a handle.

name: pipe tee
definition: A physical object that has three piping ends in T-shape, including a branch at 90 degrees.

name: pipeline
definition: A fluid conductor that consists of pipe, possibly also including pumps, valves, and control devices, intended for conveying liquids, gases, or finely divided solids.

name: piping expansion bellows
definition: A bellows that is a flexible corrugated tubular element providing axial and radial flexibility and pressure containment.

name: riser
definition: A physical object that is a vertical or near vertical pipe for the upward flow of liquid or gas.

name: spectacle blind
definition: A physical object that consists of two discs with equal thickness and outer diameter connected with a flat bar. One of the discs has a hole, while the other disc is without hole.

name: spool piece
definition: A physical object which is a short section of pipe used to connect ends of pipes/pipelines.

name: steam trap
definition: A trap that consists of a chamber into which condensed steam from steam pipes etc. is allowed to drain, and which automatically ejects it without permitting the escape of steam.

name: strainer
definition: A filter that is separating solid particles from a fluid by passing the fluid through a wire mesh, screen or metal plates containing perforations or slits.

name: tubing hanger
definition: A well string hanger that is used for production tubing. The tubing hanger incorporates a sealing system to ensure that the tubing conduit and annulus are hydraulically isolated.

name: earthing resistor
definition: A resistance through which the neutral pint of a supply system is earthed, in order to limit the current that flows on the occurrence of an earth fault.

name: anchor
definition: A physical object intended to hold an object firmly.

name: arrestor
definition: A physical object intended to prevent something to pass.

name: fire extinguisher
definition: A physical object designed to eject agents, e.g. water or a chemical, to put out fires.

secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: safety shower
definition: A shower intended for emergency situations.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: silencer
definition: A physical object intended to reduce a noise level.

name: aerator
definition: A physical object that supplies and mixes air to a liquid or solids.

name: axial compressor
definition: A dynamic compressor in which the gas is accelerated by the action of a bladed rotor and where the main flow is along the rotation axis of the rotor.

name: bearing
definition: A physical object intended to support and locate a moving or static element and capable of reducing friction and transfer forces in a connection.

name: blower
definition: A physical object intended to compress and supply air or gas at medium pressure and medium volume flow.

name: brake
definition: A physical object intended to arrest or prevent the motion of an item. Typically by means of friction.

name: centrifugal compressor
definition: A dynamic compressor in which one ore more impellers accelerate the gas and where the main flow through the impeller is radial.

name: centrifugal pump
definition: A dynamic pump that contains impellers provided with vanes to generate centrifugal force to achieve the required pressure head.

name: centrifuge
definition: A physical object that uses centrifugal force to separate phases of different densities.

name: clutch
definition: A transmission that is intended to transmit energy between two shafts providing the capability to connect and disconnect the shafts.

name: compressor
definition: A physical object that is driven by a prime mover by which energy is either constantly or periodically added to an amount of gas in order to increase its pressure.

name: diesel engine
definition: An internal combustion engine in which ignition of the fuel injected into the cylinder is performed by the heat of compression of the air charge.

name: diffuser
definition: A physical object that contains a diverging channel-shaped chamber in which part of the kinetic energy of the fluid is converted into pressure energy.

name: driver
definition: A physical object that provides rotational or reciprocating energy to driven equipment.

name: extruder
definition: A physical object that is intended to form material by forcing it in liquid phase through a shaping die by applying pressure and fix the form in the solid phase.

name: fan
definition: A physical object that is intended to deliver or exhaust volumes of vapour or gas at low differential pressure.

name: gas engine
definition: An internal combustion engine that is a reciprocating engine in which gaseous fuel is mixed with air to form a combustible mixture in a cylinder which is fired by spark ignition.

name: gas turbine
definition: A turbine that compresses air which is then mixed with fuel for combustion and expansion through a turbine section to generate relatively high power output for either mechanical drive or power generation.

name: gear box
definition: A physical object that is a casing with an arrangement of two or more gear-wheels transmitting rotating motion from the input shaft to the output shaft.

name: hood
definition: An enclosure intended to protect equipment from weather influences or to protect surroundings of equipment from equipment noise.

name: hydraulic cylinder
definition: A cylinder where the piston is actuated by pressurized hydraulic fluid.

name: hydraulic motor
definition: A motor that is intended to generate power by means of high pressure oil.

name: lubrication system
definition: A system that provides lubricant to rotating or moving items.

name: mechanical seal
definition: A seal that comprises of a set of one or more rotating and stationary seal faces, together with auxiliary hardware, separated by a film of fluid intended to reduce flow loss around a rotating shaft to an acceptable level.

name: mixer
definition: A physical object intended to be used for fluid mixing processes typically a rotating piece of equipment comprised of a driver such as a motor which rotates an agitator immersed in the fluid(s) that need to be mixed.

name: petrol engine
definition: An internal combustion engine that is an induction compression ignition exhaust engine which ignites a petrol air mixture with an electric spark.

name: pneumatic motor
definition: A motor that is driven by compressed gas. Typically air.

name: pulsation damper
definition: A pressure vessel located in both pump- and compressor piping systems in order to reduce residual pulsation fluctuations, as a result of discontinue operation effects, within an allowable level specified.

name: pump
definition: A physical object that adds or removes mechanical energy to a fluid, either constantly or periodically.

name: reciprocating compressor
definition: A positive displacement compressor in which forced reduction of gas volume takes place by the movement of a displacing element in a cylinder or enclosure.

name: rotary compressor
definition: A positive displacement compressor in which compression displacement is effected by the positive action of rotating elements.

name: spacer
definition: A physical object that is intended to keep other physical objects at a predefined distance and hence having a spacer function.

name: steam turbine
definition: A thermodynamic turbine in which steam is made to do work by expanding so as to create kinetic energy by acting on moving blades attached to a disc or drum.

name: torque converter
definition: A fluid coupling intended to allow a smooth start of a driven equipment and then keeping a nearly constant speed.

name: turbo expander
definition: An expander of the turbine type used to reduce the pressure of a gas flow by leading it through a turbine rotor by which the recovered energy is transferred into rotational energy for either power generation or mechanical drive application.

name: yoke
definition: A physical object that is an arched device intended to embrace two parts to hold or unite them in position, or to divide loads.

name: belt conveyor
definition: A conveyor that consists of a suitably tensioned endless belt made from hard wearing materials and arranged to run over rollers.

name: chain conveyor
definition: A conveyor in which endless chains are used to support slats, apron, pans, buckets, as distinct from the use of single band.

name: conveyor
definition: A physical object for moving articles or bulk material from place to place (as by an endless moving belt or a chain of receptacles).

name: cutter
definition: A physical object that is an instrument, machine, machine part, or tool that cuts.

name: feeder
definition: A closed transport device that is a gathering line tied into a trunk line.

name: forklift truck
definition: A vehicle with power operated prongs that can be raised and lowered by will, for loading, transporting and unloading goods; chiefly used in factories and warehouses.

name: hydraulic press
definition: A physical object that applies force for pressing by using fluid pressure for force multiplication.

name: roller conveyor
definition: A conveyor comprising a series of closely spaced rollers set so that their crests can support articles to be conveyed. They may be power-driven, or freely revolving. Tapered rollers are used to form bends in the conveyor line.

name: slat conveyor
definition: A conveyor consisting of a series of slats generally made of metal or wood  attached to an endless chain.

name: beam
definition: A support that is a large and straight piece of normally timber or iron forming one of the main structural member of a building or supporting structure.

name: coalescer
definition: A gravity separator where two liquid substances separates and where the substance with the less gravity can be skimmed off.

name: demister
definition: A physical object intended to catch fluid droplets.

name: electrostatic precipitator
definition: A separator intended to separate material from a solution or suspension by electrostatic charge.

name: filter
definition: A separator intended to remove solids from vapour or liquid.

name: filter cartridge
definition: A filter element intended to collect particles from a stream in a filter or strainer.

name: gas distributor
definition: A distributor intended to distribute or redistribute a vapour.

name: gutter
definition: A trough that is located along the eaves to catch and carry liquid.

name: hatch way door
definition: A hatch door used to provide and secure access into a void, vessel or riser. To enable maintenance or inspection.

name: hydro cyclone
definition: A cyclone separator intended to separate a fluid by hydraulic forces.

name: ladder
definition: A physical object intended to provide access to a certain part or level of equipment, and that consists of rungs between two profiles.

name: lifting device
definition: A physical object intended to lift or to enable lifting equipment or a part of equipment.

name: lifting lug
definition: A lug with a hole for a lifting hook intended to lift the item or a part of it.

name: pipe support
definition: A support intended to support one or more pipes.

name: process column
definition: A vertical vessel intended to enable chemical reactions or physical processes utilising differences in density of fluids and/or forced flow of fluid.

name: scraper
definition: A physical object intended to mechanically remove a deposit from a surface.

name: scrubber
definition: A distillation column intended to clean gas by washing the gas flow with water or with another liquid entering at the top of the vessel and sprayed in the gas. Typically to remove dust and small particles.

name: shell
definition: A physical object that is a layer or surface with a shape in two dimensions and length in the third dimension surrounding a space. Typically the cylindrical part of a vessel.

name: slug catcher
definition: A catcher intended to catch and separate liquid slugs from a fluid stream.

name: stripper
definition: A distillation column intended to remove light components from a fluid.

name: tank
definition: A vessel intended to contain fluid for storage. Typically a receiving or collecting function for further distribution. Typically with a vertical and cylindrical or square shape and a flat or conical bottom.

name: vessel
definition: A container intended for storage and/or processing of fluids.

name: buoy
definition: A physical object that is a floating object made for various purposes.

name: chain
definition: A mechanical cable that consist of series of interconnected links forming a flexible cable, used for sustaining a tensile load.

name: crane
definition: A lifting appliance that is a tower or derrick equipped with cables and pulleys that can lift or lower and move loads in multiple directions.

name: elevator
definition: A lift that has a chamber or compartment for moving personnel or goods.

name: fender
definition: A physical object that is a body intended to protect as a cushion (as a foam rubber or a wood float) between a boat and a dock or between two boats that lessens shocks and prevents chafing.

name: helideck
definition: A deck that is intended to provide a landing and take-off capability for helicopters.

name: life boat
definition: A boat that is intended to rescue people in an emergency case.

name: loading arm
definition: A physical object that is designed to load or unload products into or from vehicles, wagons or vessels at variable positions.

name: rope
definition: A mechanical cable that is a large stout cord of strands of fibres twisted or braided together.

name: trolley
definition: A vehicle that is intended for transporting heavy loads.

name: truck
definition: An motor vehicle that is long, low and open intended for carrying goods by road.

name: vehicle
definition: A physical object that is any conveyance (usually wheel, e.g. a cart, lorry, motorcar, but also a sledge) for goods or passengers on land.

name: actuator
definition: A physical object for changing a signal into a corresponding movement.

name: automatic identification system
definition: An automatic tracking system used on ships and by vessel traffic services (VTS) for identifying and locating vessels.

name: blast rated wall
definition: A wall that is designed to retain its integrity against a defined blast loading and fire that may subsequently follow.

name: buckle initiator
definition: A structure to control the formation of lateral buckles along a pipeline or flowline.

name: bund wall
definition: A constructed retaining wall around storage where potentially polluting substances are handled, processed or stored, for the purposes of containing any unintended escape of material from that area until such time as remedial action can be taken.

name: bus duct
definition: A physical object that is an assembly of busbar, bus duct enclosure, busbar insulation mounts etc.

name: compass
definition: An instrument that indicates either a) magnetic bearings by alignment of its needle on the magnetic poles, or b) reference bearing by radio signal, or c) change of orientation in relation to a gyromaintained line.
searchText: Required by owner-operators BP Tagging Specification

name: defibrillator
definition: An artefact that is used to control fibrillation of the heart.

secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: diverter
definition: A 'device' that is providing diversion of something from an expected course or direction.

name: electrical reactor
definition: A physical object that provides reactance in a circuit.
searchText: missing from CFIHOS - in other OO RDLs BP, Chevron & Shell Tagging Specification

name: electrical switch
definition: A switch that turns electrical current on and/or off.
searchText: Required by owner-operators BP Tagging Specification

name: emergency position indicating radio beacon
definition: A radio beacon in the mobile service the emissions of which are intended to facilitate search and rescue operations (EPIRB).
searchText: Required by owner-operators Shell Tagging Specification

name: fire wall
definition: A wall which is also a fire divider.

name: hvac duct
definition: A large sheet-metal duct or casing through which air is passed for forced-draught, ventilation or air-conditioning purposes.

name: injection point
definition: Intended to inject material. Typically it consists of a pipe connected to an item and a valve in the pipe.

name: lifting jack
definition: A lifting device, usually portable, for lifting heavy weights by force acting from below; in the commonest form, having a rack and a pinion wheel or screw and a handle turned by hand.
searchText: Required by owner-operators BP Tagging Specification

name: motor control centre
definition: A switchgear and controlgear that houses motor starters to control electric motors.
searchText: missing from CFIHOS - in other OO RDLs BP, Chevron & Shell Tagging Specification

name: pressure relief damper
definition: A gas flow damper that is used to relieve built-up pressure in a duct system to prevent damage to HVAC equipment.
searchText: Required by owner-operators BP, Chevron & Shell Tagging Specification

name: radar
definition: A physical object for detecting the presence of objects at a distance, or ascertaining their position or motion, by transmitting short radio waves and detecting or measuring their return after being reflected.
searchText: Required by owner-operators BP, Chevron & Shell Tagging Specification

name: radio beacon
definition: A radio transmitter, usually non-directional, that emits identifiable signals intended for radio direction-finding.

name: running tool
definition: A tool that can be used to install or remove machines or equipment.

name: slip ring
definition: A ring of conducting material which is attached to and rotates with a shaft, so that the electric current may be transferred to a stationary circuit through a fixed brush pressing against it.
searchText: Required by owner-operators BP Tagging Specification

name: static mixer
definition: A physical object that is intended to mix fluid by means of diverging the flow with static obstacles or by increasing locally the velocity.

name: thruster
definition: A physical object that includes a water jet or propeller used on vessels intended to provide a means to move the vessel sideways for maintaining the vessel's position without anchors.

name: wall
definition: Which is flat and typically vertical suitable for separation.

name: watercraft
definition: A physical object that is intended for water transport.

name: vacuum relief valve
definition: A relief valve that is used for pressure compensation purposes by admitting (letting in) a pressure to prevent that vacuum is forming when filling or emptying a system.

name: blow down valve

Also an enlarged pipe at the top of a casing string that serves as a funnel to guide drilling tools into the top of a well.

name: rotary pump
definition: A positive displacement pump that consists of a chamber containing gears, cams, screws, vanes, plungers or similar elements actuated by relative rotation of the drive shaft or casing and which has no separate inlet and outlet valves.

name: slide control valve
definition: A slide valve that is equipped with an actuator that manipulates a stream of fluid in the response to a signal from an external sensing element and with input of energy from an external source.
searchText: Identified as part of RDL Alignment Activity

name: slide valve
definition: A valve that opens and closes a passageway by sliding over a port.
searchText: Identified as part of RDL Alignment Activity

name: spiral heat exchanger
definition: A container intended for storage and/or processing of fluids. Relates to Spiral Plate Heat Exchanger.
searchText: missing from CFIHOS - in other OO RDLs

name: stabilizer column
definition: A column which transforms a material from an unstable state to a more stable state; for fluids typically by removing volatile components from a mixture.
searchText: missing from CFIHOS - in other OO RDLs

name: stripper column
definition: A distillation column intended to remove light components from a fluid.
searchText: missing from CFIHOS - in other OO RDLs

name: submersible connector
definition: An electrical connector capable of withstanding submersion to a specified depth.

name: swing check valve
definition: A check valve that is a check valve where the closure member is a disc which swings freely on a hinge and which opens automatically when flow is established and closes automatically when flow ceases or is reversed.
searchText: Identified as part of RDL Alignment Activity

name: vacuum circuit-breaker
definition: A circuit-breaker in which the contacts open and close within a highly evacuated envelope.
searchText: missing from CFIHOS - in other OO RDLs

name: vacuum column
definition: A distillation column intended to withstand outside pressure.

definition: A regulator ensuring constant volume in a HVAC system to reduce noise

name: modulating damper

definition: Pipework/channel/scupper designed to flow storm water (i.e. arising from atmospheric precipitation) from source areas on site to a discharge or outflow point (excludes drainage from bunded area)

definition: A machine designed to deliver a high tractive effort (or torque) at slow speeds, for the purposes of hauling a trailer or machinery

definition: A device to permit relative movement between a bridge and its support generally requiring periodic inspection and maintenance
searchText: Requested by bp as part of owner operators alignment

name: cable tray
definition: A unit or assembly of units or sections and associated fittings forming a rigid structural system used to securely fasten or support cables and raceways.
searchText: Requested by bp as part of owner operators alignment

definition: A physical object intended to contain something.
searchText: Requested by bp as part of owner operators alignment

name: crusher
definition: A mill that uses pressure or impact to reduce the particle size of solid materials.
searchText: Requested by bp as part of owner operators alignment

name: hydraulic power unit
definition: A unit minimum consisting of a engine driven hydraulic pump and a reservoir which is delivering hydraulic energy to one or more consumers
searchText: Requested by ExxonMobil as part of owner operators alignment

name: interface card
definition: A distribution board (network card) that is intended for communication between systems, to part of a system or to a computer network.
searchText: Requested by bp as part of owner operators alignment

name: lightning arrestor
definition: A lightning arrestor is a device used on electric power systems and telecommunication systems to protect the insulation and conductors of the system from the damaging effects of lightning.

name: meteorological sensor
definition: An 'equipment class' that is a class of devices engaged in meteorological observations

definition: Piping speciality item is an inline piping component that is not pre-defined within the existing piping specification

name: signal receiver
definition: A physical object that is capable of receiving a signal and where the signal can be stored, recorded or converted into a useful form.

name: subsea power and communication unit
definition: A topside unit providing electrical power and communications to the subsea control and monitoring equipment

name: subsea suction pile
definition: Suction piles are a form of fixed platform anchor in the form of an open bottomed tube embedded in the sediment and sealed at the top while in use so that lifting forces generate a pressure differential which holds the caisson down
searchText: Requested by ExxonMobil as part of owner operators alignment

name: tap
definition: A fluid regulator that controls the flow of liquid or gas from a pipe or container. Taps are often attached to a sink or bath.
searchText: Requested by ExxonMobil as part of owner operators alignment

name: tree cap
definition: A tree cap is a barrier to keep the subsea environment clean in case of any leaks above the annulus or production swab valves. It includes a mechanism to indicate the metal seals have been set within the seal bore of subsea tree.

name: voltage regulator
definition: A regulator designed to automatically maintain a constant voltage level.
