name: balustrade
definition: A railing or wall to provide a protective edge to prevent people from falling over the edge of stairs, a roof or mezzanine work area.

name: bay
definition: A compartment or area within a building with a specified function.

name: buffers
definition: An engineering dampening device to provide a controlled end stop for vehicles , trolleys or cranes and associated equipment in motion.

name: camera port
definition: A viewing / mounting portal designed specifically for the use of CCTV in hazardous areas. Built to allow for full camera rotation.

name: ceiling
definition: The upper interior surface of a room or compartment.

name: cell
definition: An Area designed to facilitate safe storage and safe working with hazardous materials.

name: cladding
definition: A covering or coating applied to a structure to make it weathertight.

name: column
definition: A support which is a cylindrical or slightly tapering body of considerably greater length than diameter, erected vertically as a support.

name: corridor
definition: A gallery or passage connecting parts of a building.

name: duct
definition: A physical channel that acts as a conduit for fluids, gases, pipes or cables to transfer from one point to another.

name: envelope opening
definition: To allow external access to and egress from a building.

name: envelope wall
definition: Equipment used for the buildings envelope to maintain structural integrity and provide a weatherproof enclosure.

name: equipment room
definition: A designated room that contains diverse types of engineering, scientific or technical equipment to support plant processes or operations.

name: fixture
definition: Equipment or apparatus which is fixed in position in a building or operational area.

name: floor
definition: A level contained within a building or industrial compound, that provides safe access and a stable working or operational area for internal structures, equipment & personnel.

name: foul water drainage
definition: Equipment used to drain foul water, and sewage.

name: groundwater protection
definition: Barrier material used to prevent moisture transmission.

name: gully drain
definition: A drainage channel that can be enclosed like a pipe or can be open with a protective grill. Typically used to collect rainwater or fluid spills in operational or production areas.

name: handrail
definition: A narrow bar that people can hold on to for support, especially when using stairs.

name: hoistwell
definition: A hoistwell or hoistway, is a shaft built into a building or structure to allow the lifting of goods and equipment. Designates a given area in a building where there may be a risk to personnel from suspended loads.

name: lagging
definition: A solid layer or covering of protective materials.

name: lead glass window
definition: A type of window designed to enable safe viewing of hazardous areas.

name: leakage collection system
definition: Equipment used to provide secondary containment of liquids.

name: lintel
definition: A structural support of concrete or metal, placed over a door or window frame or in other locations where needed.

name: local access equipment
definition: Fixed equipment used to allow ease of access.

name: lute sample point
definition: Multiple types , a point of attachment to pipework that allows samples to be taken.

name: mobile platform
definition: An aerial work platform (AWP), elevating work platform (EWP), or mobile elevating work platform (MEWP) is a mechanical device used to provide temporary access for people or equipment to inaccessible areas, usually at height.

name: rail crossing indicator
definition: A signal at a railway grade crossing that indicates the approach of a Locomotive.

name: rail key token station
definition: A safety system to govern the use of single rail tracks to ensure only one locomotive can use the track at any one time. The rail key token station controls the issue of key tokens permitting movement.

name: rail track
definition: A physical object that consists of two parallel steel rails, generally anchored perpendicular to beams or railroad ties of timber, concrete, or steel to maintain a consistent distance apart, to facilitate transport on the rails with vehicles arranged in a train without the need for steering.

name: ramp
definition: A sloping surface joining two different levels, as at the entrance or between floors of a building.

name: retaining wall
definition: Vertical structure used to resist the lateral pressure of the ground and maintains structural integrity.

name: roof
definition: A physical object that is the outside upper covering of a house or other building or the ceiling of a room or other covered part of a house, building, etc.

name: roof cover
definition: A cover intended to cover an outer roof.

name: room
definition: Part of the inside of a building that is divided from other areas by walls and a door and that has its own floor and ceiling.

name: sanitary ware
definition: Equipment used to allow drainage of foul water.

name: secondary wall
definition: Equipment used for room separation.

name: shield door
definition: A hinged or sliding barrier used to control access to a high hazard area, made from robust materials used to protect personnel from exposure to hazards.

name: sign
definition: Visual signs to convey information or messages relating to item identification and locations. Conforming to standards as per type.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: staircase
definition: A stepped construction designed to enable users to move between floors or levels within a building or working area.

name: structural ancillary frame
definition: A framework that is used to add to existing steelwork, to bear the weight of extra shielding or coating or protecting pipework.

name: structural cell wall
definition: A wall, used to maintain structural integrity, and provide Shielding and Containment.

name: structural floor
definition: The lower enclosing surface of a room, used to support imposed loads.

name: structural frame
definition: Installed equipment used to provide structural support.

name: structural wall
definition: A wall used to maintain structural integrity, and provide separation.

name: superstructure
definition: The external fabric of a building that is visible above ground.

name: surface water collection system
definition: Equipment used to direct surface water flow.

name: trench
definition: A narrow excavation of considerable length cut into the ground.

name: tv access plug
definition: A means of connection for TV equipment to link to remote cameras located inside a shielded area. Also a means of inserting an inspection Camera into a viewing port to enable viewing within restricted access areas.

name: vault
definition: An Area designed to facilitate safe and secure storage of hazardous materials.

name: viewport
definition: A type of portal designed to enable a safe but limited view into a hazardous area.

name: eye wash bottle
definition: Renewable eye wash bottles mounted in fixed locations.
searchText: health, safety and environment equipment class
secondaryLabel: Parent: health, safety and environment equipment class

name: automatic circuit recloser
definition: A self-controlled device for making, carrying, and automatically interrupting and reclosing an alternating-current circuit.

name: pumpjack
definition: An aboveground drive for a reciprocating piston pump in an oil well.

name: boat
definition: A small open vessel for travelling on water.

name: rescue boat
definition: A rescue boat designed for rescuing personnel.

name: pinch control valve
definition: A pinch valve is an actuated membrane valve that is comprising a flexible tube, either exposed or enclosed in a body. The tube is pinched to close by mechanical means.

name: diaphragm tank
definition: A pressure tank divided into two areas: the upper is a fluid storage area and the lower is a gas pressure area with the two areas separated by a diaphragm.

name: direct contact heat exchanger
definition: A heat exchanger that allows contact between the hot and cold fluids.

name: double pipe heat exchanger
definition: A heat exchanger that consists of two co-axial pipes of different sizes, where one fluid passes though the  inner pipe and the other fluid passes through the space between the inner and the outer pipes.

name: harmonic filter
definition: A physical object that is a passive circuit that attenuates all signals except those within one or more frequency bands.

name: heater treater
definition: A 2 or 3-phase separator vessel that utilizes heat and mechanical separation devices to facilitate the separation of oil-water emulsions.

name: long-stroke pumpjack
definition: A non-beam type pump jack that uses a longer stroke.

name: pinch valve
definition: A membrane valve that is comprising a flexible tube, either exposed or enclosed in a body. The tube is pinched to close by mechanical means.

name: piling
definition: Heavy stakes or posts installed to support the foundations of a superstructure.

name: pin-actuated pressure relief valve
definition: A non-reclosing pressure-relief device actuated by the static differential pressure between the inlet and outlet of the device.

name: plate fin heat exchanger
definition: A non-corrugated plate heat exchanger that has flat core plates separated by u-shaped fins or corrugated plates.

name: pneumatic conveyor
definition: A conveyor for transporting dry, free flowing, granular material in suspension within a pipe or duct by means of a high-velocity airstream or by the energy of expanding compressed air within a comparatively dense column of fluidized or aerated material.

name: beam pumpjack
definition: A pump jack that converts rotary motion to vertical reciprocating motion.

name: silo
definition: A vessel that has a bottom in the shape of a cone and is intended to store solid particles.

name: thermoelectric generator
definition: A solid state device that converts heat flux (temperature differences) directly into electrical energy.

name: tote tank
definition: A tank which is supposed to be transported.

name: trip and throttle valve
definition: Trip & throttle valves provide flow control and emergency shut-off operation for steam turbines in a single valve assembly.

name: underground storage tank
definition: A tank (or a combination of tanks) and connected underground piping having at least 10 percent of their combined volume underground.

name: vacuum pump
definition: A pump that utilizes a liquid annulus held by centrifugal force around the inside of a casing by a single rotor-impeller to compress vapour isothermally.

name: vibrating conveyor
definition: A conveyor that is a tubular or flat trough with slides, to which vibrators are attached. The latter impart an upward and forward conveying movement to bulk materials in the trough.

name: windsock
definition: A windsock, or wind cone, is a conical textile tube that resembles a giant sock. Windsocks can be used as a basic guide to wind direction and speed.

name: wind turbine
definition: A turbine that converts the kinetic energy of the wind into electrical power.

name: water treatment plant tag
definition: Functional tag representing an integrated facility that treats raw water to produce potable, process, industrial or utility water.
searchText: water and desalination functional tag class
Separates the functional plant tag from the physical water-treatment plant class.
secondaryLabel: Parent: water and desalination functional tag class

name: desalination plant tag
definition: Functional tag representing a facility that produces freshwater from seawater or brackish water using membrane or thermal desalination processes.
searchText: Provides a functional designation for desalination facilities and their plant-level information requirements.

name: raw-water intake system tag
definition: Functional tag representing the system that abstracts and conveys seawater, surface water or other raw water to the treatment plant.
searchText: Provides a functional designation for raw-water abstraction and intake systems.

name: intake screening system tag
definition: Functional tag representing screens and associated equipment that remove debris from raw-water intake flow.
searchText: Distinguishes the screening function within a raw-water intake system.

name: raw-water pumping system tag
definition: Functional tag representing pumps and associated systems that transfer raw water from the intake to the treatment process.
searchText: Distinguishes the raw-water pumping function and associated design duty.

name: pretreatment system tag
definition: Functional tag representing treatment processes that condition feed water before membrane, thermal or downstream treatment stages.
searchText: Groups pretreatment functions such as coagulation, flotation and filtration.

name: coagulation and flocculation system tag
definition: Functional tag representing chemical coagulation and flocculation used to destabilize and aggregate suspended or colloidal matter.
searchText: Provides a functional tag for coagulation and flocculation process performance.

name: dissolved-air flotation system tag
definition: Functional tag representing dissolved-air flotation used to separate suspended solids, algae or flocs from water.
searchText: Provides a functional tag for dissolved-air flotation performance and equipment.

name: filtration system tag
definition: Functional tag representing media or cartridge filtration used to remove suspended solids from water.
searchText: Provides a generic filtration function above media and cartridge filter equipment.

name: ultrafiltration system tag
definition: Functional tag representing an ultrafiltration membrane system used for water pretreatment or clarification.
searchText: Provides a functional tag for ultrafiltration process and membrane information.

name: microfiltration system tag
definition: Functional tag representing a microfiltration membrane system used for water pretreatment or solids separation.
searchText: Provides a functional tag for microfiltration process and membrane information.

name: reverse-osmosis system tag
definition: Functional tag representing a reverse-osmosis treatment system that separates dissolved constituents using pressure-driven membranes.
searchText: Provides a functional tag for reverse-osmosis design and performance information.

name: reverse-osmosis train tag
definition: Functional tag representing an independently operable reverse-osmosis train comprising pumps, pressure vessels, membranes and associated controls.
searchText: Supports train-level capacity, availability and performance tracking.

name: membrane element tag
definition: Functional tag representing a replaceable membrane element installed within a membrane pressure vessel.
searchText: Supports membrane element identification, performance and replacement history.

name: high-pressure pumping system tag
definition: Functional tag representing the pumping function that raises reverse-osmosis feed pressure to the required operating pressure.
searchText: Supports pump duty, efficiency and condition information for the high-pressure feed function.

name: energy-recovery system tag
definition: Functional tag representing equipment that recovers hydraulic energy from high-pressure concentrate or brine.
searchText: Supports energy-recovery performance and maintainable-equipment relationships.

name: thermal desalination system tag
definition: Functional tag representing a thermal desalination system that produces freshwater through evaporation and condensation.
searchText: Provides a functional tag for MSF, MED or vapour-compression desalination systems.

name: post-treatment system tag
definition: Functional tag representing treatment applied after primary desalination or treatment to stabilize and condition product water.
searchText: Groups product-water conditioning, remineralisation and final treatment functions.

name: remineralisation system tag
definition: Functional tag representing a system that adds alkalinity, hardness or stabilizing minerals to treated water.
searchText: Supports product-water stability and remineralisation information.

name: disinfection system tag
definition: Functional tag representing the final or intermediate disinfection function for treated water.
searchText: Supports disinfection method, dose, residual and performance information.

name: chemical dosing system tag
definition: Functional tag representing chemical storage, preparation and metered dosing into a water-treatment process.
searchText: Supports chemical identity, dosing rate, storage and safety information.

name: clean-in-place system tag
definition: Functional tag representing equipment and procedures used to circulate cleaning solutions through membranes or process equipment.
searchText: Supports cleaning chemical, frequency and maintainable-equipment information.

name: product-water storage system tag
definition: Functional tag representing tanks and associated systems used to store treated or desalinated water.
searchText: Supports product-water storage capacity and quality controls.

name: product-water pumping system tag
definition: Functional tag representing pumps and associated equipment used to transfer product water to distribution or consumers.
searchText: Supports product-water pumping duty, availability and condition information.

name: brine management system tag
definition: Functional tag representing concentrate collection, handling, treatment and discharge from a desalination process.
searchText: Supports brine flow, salinity, environmental and discharge information.

name: zero-liquid-discharge system tag
definition: Functional tag representing a treatment system designed to recover water and prevent routine liquid effluent discharge.
searchText: Supports high-recovery brine concentration and solids-management functions.

name: wastewater treatment plant tag
definition: Functional tag representing an integrated facility that treats municipal or industrial wastewater to an agreed effluent or reuse standard.
searchText: water and desalination functional tag class

name: sludge treatment system tag

name: water-quality analysis system tag
definition: Functional tag representing online, laboratory-interface or package analyzers used to measure water-quality parameters.
searchText: Supports analyzer parameter, range, location and quality-monitoring information.

name: water plant control and monitoring system tag
